items.title: Alonso hails Caicedo’s impact as Chelsea crush Bournemouth
items.author: William Schomberg
items.creator: William Schomberg
items.summary: Chelsea manager Xabi Alonso has had to wait until October to see what his side can do with midfielder Moises Caicedo properly back in the team and he was delighted with his role in the 5-1 demolition of Bournemouth in the Premier League on Saturday.
items.body:
Chelsea manager Xabi Alonso has had to wait until October to see what his side can do with midfielder Moises Caicedo properly back in the team and he was delighted with his role in the 5-1 demolition of Bournemouth in the Premier League on Saturday.
Alonso – who oversaw two victories in his first two matches in charge of Chelsea before failing to win any of the next three - gave Caicedo his first start of the season after being sidelined with a calf problem.
The Ecuadorian, 24, provided a stronger shield for Chelsea's defence that has looked shaky since the campaign began and he formed an effective partnership with 36 year-old Jordan Henderson who scored twice.
Alonso stressed the importance of Caicedo's return after a brief appearance in August when he lasted only 14 minutes as a substitute before having to limp off.
"With him we have a better midfield area and when you are better in the middle you have a more complete team and something to build around," the Spaniard told reporters.
"I am so happy that Moi is feeling better because he is going to be a key player for us. We knew that and we have seen (it) today."
In further encouragement for Chelsea fans, right back Marco Palestra - who signed from Atalanta in Italy in the close season but was injured soon after - made his debut as a substitute.
The two goals from Henderson and another two from Joao Pedro – both players who have also been in the medical room – and a Morgan Rogers strike underscored Chelsea’s reputation as one of the Premier League’s entertainers this season.
They added to their tally of early goals as they rushed into a 2-0 lead within 149 seconds and got their third a little more than 30 seconds after the start of the second half.
Cole Palmer celebrated signing a contract extension by providing two assists, adding to the signs that he is getting back to top form.
The only worries for Alonso were Chelsea's failure to keep a clean sheet for a 22nd Premier League game in a row when Bournemouth striker Evanilson briefly gave the visitors hope in the second half, and the absence of captain Reece James.
Alonso said James - who has missed long spells in recent seasons due to hamstring problems - had suffered a knee injury in training on Friday.
Chelsea will face stiffer tests this season than Bournemouth who have not won any of their six games so far under new manager Marco Rose and were missing key players including England midfielder Alex Scott and strikers Eli Kroupi and Justin Kluivert.
Alonso said Chelsea lost control of the game briefly when Bournemouth pulled a goal back through Evanilson to make it 3-1 in the 51st minute, but he took encouragement from the way they finished off the game with two goals in three minutes later on.
"From today we take positives for the future," he said.

Hurricane Simon strengthens to Category 4 off Mexico coast

10 October, 2026 11:00 pm IST

Oct 10 – Hurricane Simon strengthened into a powerful Category 4 storm off Mexico’s Pacific coast on Saturday, threatening destructive winds, storm surges and potentially deadly flooding as it approaches landfall.

The US National Hurricane Center said Simon was located about 115 miles (185 km) south-southwest of Manzanillo on Saturday morning, packing maximum sustained winds of 150 mph (240 kph) as it moved northward.

Simon is expected to approach the west-central coast of Mexico as a major hurricane late Saturday or early Sunday, and some additional strengthening remains possible before landfall, the NHC said.

Show Full Article

A hurricane warning was in effect for portions of Mexico’s Pacific coast south of the beach resort of Puerto Vallarta, including the area around Manzanillo, Mexico’s largest Pacific port. A tropical storm watch was in effect farther south toward Lazaro Cardenas.

The NHC urged residents in the warning area, which also includes the Islas Marias archipelago offshore, to rush preparations to protect life and property.

“Simon has strengthened incredibly quickly, and that’s what makes storms like this so dangerous,” said AccuWeather meteorologist Dan Pydynowski.

“Strong winds could damage homes and businesses, while flooding and mudslides could wash out roads and make it difficult for emergency crews to reach some communities. Even after the storm passes, power outages and damaged infrastructure could make recovery challenging.”

Mexican authorities warned that heavy rainfall was expected in the states of Guerrero, Michoacan, Colima and Jalisco.

The NHC said Simon was expected to produce 10 to 20 inches (25 to 51 cm) of rain across portions of southwestern Mexico through Sunday, with isolated totals of up to 30 inches (76 cm) possible in parts of Michoacan, Colima and Jalisco. The rainfall could trigger life-threatening flooding and mudslides, especially in mountainous areas.

A storm surge is expected along the coast near and to the east of where the center makes landfall, accompanied by large and destructive waves, the NHC said. Swells generated by Simon are expected to affect portions of Mexico’s southwestern and west-central coast over the coming days, creating dangerous surf and rip current conditions.

Simon is forecast to be near or just inland of Mexico’s west-central Pacific coast on Sunday.

Last week, Hurricane Polo made landfall on the Baja California Peninsula as a Category 2 storm, toppling trees and utility poles, flooding streets and causing other property damage.

(Reporting by Sarah Kinosian in Mexico City; Editing by Edmund Klamann)

O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, pediu neste sábado uma nova liderança na Ucrânia, criticando duramente o presidente ucraniano Volodymyr Zelenskiy e exortando o líder de Kiev a parar de atacar refinarias de petróleo russas.

“Sugiro que eles escolham um novo líder capaz de fechar um acordo”, declarou ele, referindo-se a Zelenskiy.

items.title: Rain washes out qualifying, puts Kyle Larson on pole at Charlotte
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: CONCORD, N.C. -- Persistent rain forced cancellation or postponement of all NASCAR on-track activity on Saturday at Charlotte Motor Speedway.
items.body:
CONCORD, N.C. -- Persistent rain forced cancellation or postponement of all NASCAR on-track activity on Saturday at Charlotte Motor Speedway.
The cancellation of qualifying for the NASCAR Cup Series race puts Kyle Larson on the pole for Sunday's Bank of America 400, the sixth race in the Chase presented by Mobil 1 (3 p.m. ET on USA, PRN and SiriusXM NASCAR Radio).
In addition, the Blue Cross NC 300 NASCAR O'Reilly Auto Parts Series race, scheduled for Saturday afternoon, has been postponed until 8 p.m. ET on Sunday night, following the Bank of America 400. The Blue Cross NC 300 will be broadcast on CW, PRN and SiriusXM NASCAR Radio.
With the starting order set by a metric formula that combines the results of the previous race with owner points position, Larson, the Chase leader by 40 points over second-place Denny Hamlin, will start beside Chase Briscoe, last Sunday's winner at Las Vegas Motor Speedway.
However, the driver of the No. 5 Hendrick Motorsports Chevrolet doesn't feel the top starting spot will give him as big an advantage as starting on the front row for the third Chase race at Kansas Speedway, where he started second and took control of the race.
"I actually think (Charlotte) is a harder track to maintain a lead, because the grip in the surface is a lot less," Larson said. "At Kansas, you can maintain the lead pretty easily for three quarters of the run, and then they start coming at you.
"From the (Coca-Cola) 600 (at Charlotte in May), I got out to a lead a couple of different times. I guess cars were just faster and passed me with no problem. ... But, yeah, if our car is good, we're going to try our best to get the lead and maintain it."
Christopher Bell, third in the standings and 55 points behind Larson, starts 17th after a power steering failure at Las Vegas. Fourth-place Joey Logano, 71 points back, is seventh on the grid beside fellow Chase driver Bubba Wallace.
Hamlin will take the green flag from the 12th position.
Saturday's qualifying for the O'Reilly Series race also was canceled, leaving Chase driver Carson Kvapil on the pole with Las Vegas winner Corey Day beside him. Defending series champion Jesse Love starts third beside rookie Brent Crews.
Series leader Sheldon Creed is eighth on the grid.
--By Reid Spencer, NASCAR Wire Service

items.title: Motor racing Mercedes' Antonelli says car 'in a better place' but Russell takes 'step backwards'
items.author: Tom Westbrook
items.creator: Tom Westbrook
items.summary: Kimi Antonelli said Mercedes have got to the bottom of the issues on the new upgrade on his car after he qualified fourth-fastest on Saturday in Singapore, but George Russell feels he has taken a "step backwards" after a crash in the sprint.
items.body:
Kimi Antonelli said Mercedes have got to the bottom of the issues on the new upgrade on his car after he qualified fourth-fastest on Saturday in Singapore, but George Russell feels he has taken a "step backwards" after a crash in the sprint.
Formula One championship leader Antonelli, who leads Russell by 89 points, is looking to become the youngest ever world champion at 20 and will line up behind Red Bull's Max Verstappen and the Ferraris of Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton.
Antonelli said he and the team are beginning to come to grips with a new upgrade package that was introduced in Sepang -- where he finished second -- while Russell reverted to an older setup that helped him win in Baku last month.
"It definitely felt in a better place today, even though the window is very small where the car operates," Antonelli said after Saturday's qualifying session.
"The team did a really good job because, first of all, we found the issues. Now we're able to understand more of the package and now it's more about trying to find the right window with the setup to make sure that the package works at its best.
"Let's see what we can do from P4 but a podium will be very good."
'TWO TEST PILOTS' Mercedes team boss Toto Wolff had said on Friday that it had been tricky to assess the upgrade package over consecutive race weekends, with the team running "two test pilots" on the Marina Bay Street Circuit to weigh up the upgrade's value.
"On Kimi's side the updates seem to have worked now," Wolff said.
"He and his engineers have dialled out the problems and we got closer and closer. We're missing a tenth and a half or two-tenths, and that is, at least for qualifying, positive.
"It will take some more proof of concept until I'm feeling warm and fuzzy. But we will have more data tomorrow, in the race, whether we can have less degradation."
Wolff, who on Friday had dismissed suggestions of favouritism within the Mercedes team, said Russell had made a rare mistake to spin out of the lead in the sprint, reminiscent of a last-lap crash at Singapore in 2023 that cost him a shot at victory.
Russell, who was sixth-fastest in Q3 but is set to start at the back of the grid due to an engine penalty, said he used the qualifying session to test whether his car was in working order after retiring from the sprint.
"Something was a bit odd because we had great pace yesterday, and Kimi's in a similar position to where he was yesterday," Russell said.
"But I've taken a step backwards and the car didn't feel quite the same... It'll be tough racing (tomorrow)."

items.title: Papa Leão condena pena de morte enquanto Trump pondera execução transmitida ao vivo
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O papa Leão 14 renovou sua condenação à pena de morte, neste sábado, afirmando que ela viola a santidade da vida humana e priva as pessoas da chance de redenção, dias depois de o Pentágono anunciar que planeja transmitir ao vivo uma execução.
items.body:
O papa Leão 14 renovou sua condenação à pena de morte, neste sábado, afirmando que ela viola a santidade da vida humana e priva as pessoas da chance de redenção, dias depois de o Pentágono anunciar que planeja transmitir ao vivo uma execução.
As Forças Armadas dos EUA transmitirão ao vivo execução por fuzilamento de um atirador que matou 13 pessoas na base militar de Fort Hood em 2009, afirmou o secretário de Defesa, Pete Hegseth, na quinta-feira, no que seria uma transmissão sem precedentes de uma execução nos EUA.
“O bem comum pode ser salvaguardado e os requisitos da justiça podem ser atendidos sem recorrer à pena capital”, afirmou Leão, o primeiro papa dos Estados Unidos, em uma postagem nas redes sociais, sem mencionar o plano do Pentágono.
“A pena de morte é inadmissível porque constitui um ataque à inviolabilidade e à dignidade da pessoa”, acrescentou ele na mensagem publicada no Dia Mundial contra a Pena de Morte.
Nidal Hasan, um ex-psiquiatra do Exército, deve se tornar a primeira pessoa a ser executada por um pelotão de fuzilamento pelas Forças Armadas dos EUA desde 1945.
O plano de transmissão ao vivo, defendido por Hegseth, gerou oposição de parlamentares, inclusive dos colegas republicanos do presidente Donald Trump, de líderes religiosos e de observadores internacionais.
O próprio Trump afirmou que ainda não decidiu se permitirá a transmissão ao vivo, enquanto o vice-presidente JD Vance, que é católico, expressou ceticismo quanto à possibilidade de o Pentágono prosseguir com a transmissão ao vivo da execução marcada para 3 de dezembro.
Vance também disse que não assistiria à transmissão ao vivo caso ela ocorresse.
O plano de execução surge em meio a um debate acirrado nos EUA sobre a pena de morte, após uma injeção letal mal executada em uma mulher do Tennessee na semana passada.

items.title: Report: Cards finalizing trade of WR Marvin Harrison Jr.
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Arizona Cardinals are finalizing a deal to trade former first-round draft pick Marvin Harrison Jr., NFL Network and ESPN reported Saturday.
items.body:
The Arizona Cardinals are finalizing a deal to trade former first-round draft pick Marvin Harrison Jr., NFL Network and ESPN reported Saturday.
The trade destination and the return for the third-year wide receiver were not reported.
Harrison has been informed of the trade and will be inactive for Sunday's game against the visiting Detroit Lions as the deal is finalized, per the report.
The NFL trade deadline is Nov. 10.
Trade speculation heated up after Harrison, who previously did not have a representative, hired agents Todd France and Tory Dandy on Sept. 23.
Harrison, 24, the No. 4 pick in the 2024 NFL Draft, has just five catches for 85 yards and one touchdown in four games (four starts) this season for the Cardinals (1-3).
The son of Pro Football Hall of Fame wideout Marvin Harrison has recorded 108 career receptions (on 202 targets) for 1,578 yards and 13 touchdowns in 33 games (30 starts). He recorded 885 yards as a rookie in 17 games (16 starts) in 2004 and 608 in 12 games last season.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Report: Warriors signing G Brandin Podziemski to $110M extension
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Golden State Warriors have agreed to a five-year, $110 million extension with guard Brandin Podziemski.
items.body:
The Golden State Warriors have agreed to a five-year, $110 million extension with guard Brandin Podziemski.
Agent Bill Duffy confirmed the details to ESPN on Saturday. His client avoided restricted free agency next summer.
The deal with Podziemski, 23, is fully guaranteed and includes a mutual option for the final season in 2031-32.
After earning $5.6 million in the final year of his rookie deal in 2026-27, he will earn $18.9 million next season.
Podziemski averaged 13.8 points, 5.1 rebounds and 3.7 assists while playing all 82 games (43 starts) last season. He shot 37.1% from behind the arc and his 153 made 3-pointers were second on the team to Stephen Curry's 190.
Since being drafted in the first round (19th overall) in 2023, Podziemski has averaged 11.6 points, 5.3 rebounds and 3.6 assists in 220 games (104 starts) with Golden State.
The Warriors open the regular season on the road against the Los Angeles Lakers on Oct. 21.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Grizzlies C Isaiah Stewart out 2 weeks with ankle sprain
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Memphis Grizzlies center Isaiah Stewart will miss the regular-season opener with an ankle injury.
items.body:
Memphis Grizzlies center Isaiah Stewart will miss the regular-season opener with an ankle injury.
The team announced Friday that Stewart has a moderate left ankle sprain and will be re-evaluated in two weeks.
The Grizzlies tip off the season at home against the Utah Jazz on Oct. 21. The timeline means he could be available for the second game on Oct. 23 against the host Golden State Warriors.
Stewart, 25, sustained the injury in the first quarter of Monday's preseason opener against the host Atlanta Hawks.
Memphis acquired Stewart and the remainder of his four-year, $60 million contract during an offseason trade with the Detroit Pistons. He has a base salary of $15 million for this season and a $15 million team option in 2027-28.
He averaged 10.0 points, 5.0 rebounds, a career-high 1.6 blocks and 22.7 minutes in 58 games (13 starts) last season with the Pistons. Stewart has career averages of 8.8 points and 6.8 boards in 365 games (194 starts) with Detroit.
Stewart has been suspended five times by the NBA, most recently last February for seven games for leaving the bench during a brawl between the Pistons and Charlotte Hornets.
The Portland Trail Blazers selected Stewart with the 16th overall pick in the 2020 NBA Draft and soon traded him to Detroit, where he made the NBA All-Rookie second team in 2020-21.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Léon XIV condamne la peine de mort, alors que Trump envisage de diffuser une exécution en direct
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Le pape Léon XIV a réitéré samedi sa condamnation de la peine de mort, soulignant qu'elle portait atteinte au caractère sacré de la vie humaine et privait les personnes de toute chance de rédemption, quelques jours après que le Pentagone a annoncé son intention de diffuser une exécution en direct.
items.body:
Le pape Léon XIV a réitéré samedi sa condamnation de la peine de mort, soulignant qu'elle portait atteinte au caractère sacré de la vie humaine et privait les personnes de toute chance de rédemption, quelques jours après que le Pentagone a annoncé son intention de diffuser une exécution en direct.
L'armée américaine a prévu de retransmettre en direct l'exécution de Nidal Hasan, qui avait tué 13 personnes sur la base militaire de Fort Hood au Texas en 2009, ce qui serait sans précédent aux Etats-Unis.
"Il est possible de préserver le bien commun et de répondre aux exigences de la justice sans recourir à la peine capitale : des systèmes de détention efficaces ont été mis en place, qui protègent les citoyens tout en ne privant pas totalement les coupables de la possibilité d'une rédemption", a déclaré Léon XIV, premier pape originaire des États-Unis, dans un message sur les réseaux sociaux.
"La peine de mort est inadmissible car elle porte atteinte à l'inviolabilité et à la dignité de la personne", a-t-il ajouté dans cette déclaration, publiée à l'occasion de la Journée mondiale contre la peine de mort et qui ne fait pas explicitement référence au projet du Pentagone.
Nidal Hasan, un ancien psychiatre de l'armée de terre condamné à mort en 2013 par un tribunal militaire, doit être fusillé par un peloton d'exécution le 3 décembre.
L'armée américaine n'a pas eu recours au peloton d'exécution pour un condamné à mort depuis 1945, peu après la fin de la Seconde Guerre mondiale.
Le projet de diffusion en direct de l'exécution, défendu par le secrétaire à la Défense Pete Hegseth, a été critiqué par certains élus républicains et stratèges conservateurs, de même que par des chefs religieux et des observateurs internationaux.
Donald Trump a dit "approuver absolument" l'exécution mais ne pas avoir encore pris de décision sur la diffusion en direct. Le vice-président J.D. Vance a pour sa part déclaré qu'il ignorait si l'exécution serait bel et bien retransmise mais que, si tel était le cas, il ne la regarderait pas.
Ce projet intervient dans un contexte de débat intense sur la peine de mort aux États-Unis, à la suite de l'injection létale ratée d'une femme dans le Tennessee, la semaine dernière.
items.raw_description: Le pape Léon XIV a réitéré samedi sa condamnation de la peine de mort, soulignant qu'elle portait atteinte au caractère sacré de la vie humaine et privait les personnes de toute chance de rédemption, quelques jours après que le Pentagone a annoncé son intention de diffuser une exécution en direct.

items.title: Drones ayudan a Shell a combatir los daños millonarios de los huracanes
items.author: Lucia Kassai
items.summary: La empresa espera reanudar la producción más rápidamente y ahorrar decenas de millones de dólares utilizando drones para realizar inspecciones antes de que haya pasado la tormenta.
items.body: Bloomberg — Cuando los huracanes azotan el Golfo de México, las empresas petroleras pueden perder millones de dólares mientras esperan el visto bueno para reanudar la producción. Shell Plc ( SHEL ) cree que una flota de drones puede ayudar a acortar esa espera. Ver más: Huracán Isaías trae lluvia, viento y deja a miles de personas sin electricidad El gigante energético británico ha obtenido una autorización clave de EE.UU. para convertirse en el primer productor de petróleo en utilizar drones en plataformas marinas. Se trata de una iniciativa con la que Shell espera, a la larga, poder reanudar la producción más rápidamente tras fenómenos meteorológicos de gran magnitud, como el huracán Isaías, y ahorrarse decenas de millones de dólares en los próximos años. “Cuando llega un huracán y tenemos que evacuar, no producimos ni una sola gota de petróleo”, afirmó Kevin McMahon, vicepresidente de activos de producción en el Golfo de América. “Disponer de drones en las plataformas nos permite realizar inspecciones antes de que haya pasado la tormenta, lo que nos da ventaja”, señaló en una entrevista. La empresa, el mayor productor del Golfo de México, afirmó que la inversión asciende a “miles”, mientras que podría ahorrar casi US$50 millones en tres años al reanudar la producción un día antes tras tormentas de gran intensidad. Se espera que el primer dron de su proyecto IRN-Maiden —que luce un logotipo inspirado en su homónimo, la banda británica de heavy metal— se instale antes de que termine el año. El dron se ubicará en una de las plataformas del proyecto Mars, un yacimiento de petróleo y gas en aguas profundas del Golfo, a unas 130 millas (209 kilómetros) al sur de Nueva Orleans. La reanudación de las operaciones tras un huracán es un tema de gran actualidad. El huracán Isaías, la primera tormenta de este tipo en el Atlántico este año, se dirige a toda velocidad hacia la costa del Golfo de Estados Unidos y se esperaba que tocara tierra a última hora del viernes o a primera hora del sábado. A fecha de viernes, se había paralizado aproximadamente el 72% de la producción de crudo estadounidense en el Golfo de México, mientras que casi 500.000 barriles diarios de capacidad de refinado se encuentran en la trayectoria prevista de la tormenta o cerca de ella. Shell ha informado de que ha suspendido la producción en cuatro de sus plataformas petrolíferas de la región. Los huracanes, que se están volviendo cada vez más destructivos a medida que el calentamiento de los océanos alimenta tormentas más intensas, se encuentran entre las mayores amenazas para la producción petrolera en el Golfo de México. Las plataformas pueden permanecer cerradas durante días o semanas tras el paso de una tormenta, y las tripulaciones no pueden regresar hasta que los inspectores determinen que las condiciones son seguras. Los vientos que superan las 170 millas por hora y las olas que se elevan por encima de las instalaciones marítimas pueden dificultar especialmente esas evaluaciones. La puesta en marcha de una plataforma petrolífera es un proceso meticuloso que consta de varios pasos, entre los que se incluye el envío de un helicóptero para evaluar si las condiciones son seguras antes de permitir el regreso del personal. A través de prismáticos de largo alcance, los inspectores utilizan cámaras para capturar fotos y vídeos y transmiten las imágenes al centro de recuperación tras tormentas de Shell. Este es un proceso que puede llevar un día entero, incluyendo la movilización de inspectores, helicópteros y el tiempo de espera. A veces, las tripulaciones deben esperar a que pase el huracán antes de poder sacar nada de tierra firme. Mediante el uso de drones, la empresa espera ahorrar tiempo desplegando estos dispositivos alimentados por batería directamente desde las plataformas. Los drones, de 2 pies y medio de ancho —aproximadamente del tamaño de dos pizzas grandes colocadas una al lado de la otra—, pueden sobrevolar y rodear la instalación en alta mar, del tamaño de un campo de fútbol , utilizando potentes lentes que pueden acercar y alejar la imagen a comando para detectar fugas y equipos dañados, al tiempo que transmiten informes en directo a tierra a través de Starlink, la banda ancha por satélite de SpaceX (). Aunque los drones se han utilizado ampliamente para inspeccionar refinerías, oleoductos y plantas químicas, su uso ha sido limitado en aguas internacionales, donde suelen ubicarse las plataformas marinas. Tras un proceso de dos años, Shell obtuvo a principios de 2026 una exención de la Administración Federal de Aviación que permite a la empresa operar sus drones más allá del punto en el que el piloto puede verlos a simple vista. Los drones de Shell están registrados como aeronaves y tendrán su base en una caja a prueba de huracanes. “Para cuando otros operadores consigan llevar esos helicópteros o aviones hasta allí, probablemente ya habremos realizado inspecciones increíblemente detalladas de los daños y ya estaremos empezando a planificar cuáles serán los siguientes pasos”, afirmó Ross Doak, ingeniero sénior de robótica al frente del proyecto. Las aseguradoras de bienes en EE.UU. llevan utilizando drones de largo alcance para evaluar los daños causados por las tormentas desde el huracán Florence en 2018. Las empresas de suministro eléctrico los llevan utilizando incluso más tiempo para inspeccionar parques eólicos y solares y detectar equipos defectuosos. Investigadores de la Administración Nacional Oceánica y Atmosférica de EE. UU. también han experimentado con aeronaves no tripuladas y vehículos oceánicos para recopilar datos con el fin de mejorar las predicciones de huracanes, y Noruega lleva utilizando drones en el Mar del Norte. El director ejecutivo de Shell, Wael Sawan, se ha marcado como objetivo recortar gastos desde que asumió el mando en 2023, con el objetivo de reducir los costes entre US$5.000 y US$7.000 millones para finales de 2028. Shell tiene previsto poner en marcha al menos cinco drones más en el Golfo de México en 2027 y está valorando la posibilidad de ampliar los proyectos a otras instalaciones marítimas en lugares como el Mar del Norte y África. --Con la colaboración de Mitchell Ferman y Lauren Rosenthal. items.title: Australia's Renshaw savours redemption after decade-long wait for second test ton
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Matt Renshaw's imperious 190 for Australia put the visitors in the driving seat on day two of the first test against South Africa in Durban on Saturday and provided redemption after he wondered if his chance to play test cricket again had gone.
items.body:
Matt Renshaw's imperious 190 for Australia put the visitors in the driving seat [USN:L1N45W02Z TEXT:"on day two"] of the first test against South Africa in Durban on Saturday and provided redemption after he wondered if his chance to play test cricket again had gone.
Renshaw’s career-best score helped Australia recover from 124 for six to make 390 in their first innings and comes almost 10 years after his only other test century against Pakistan.
"I never thought I'd be here this long," the 30-year-old said. "I think once I took a few years out of the team, and had an opportunity in 2023 and didn't take it, you probably think that you're never going to get this opportunity again.
"When I hit the ball (for a century), I was screaming at it, ‘Go, go, go!’ And it just hit me at once. And Nathan (Lyon) at the other end is pretty emotional. So to see that, it was pretty special."
Renshaw had scored single figures in 11 of his previous 13 test innings before this one dating back nine years.
"I always wanted that second one (century). I had the monkey off my back early with that first one but, for me, this one was about all the stuff that has come in the last 10 years. All the hard work, all the failures, all the success."
Renshaw believes the lows in his career provided valuable experience in Durban.
"All the stuff that I've done in the past 10 years has probably led me to this moment. I wouldn't be where I was without all the failures," he said.
"We're quick to judge failures, but I think some of the best learning has come from failures.
"I felt calm at times. I didn't probably look calm but I think everything led up to this and culminated in this innings."
With South Africa 27 for one in reply and trailing by 363, Renshaw expects the wicket to get trickier to bat on.
"It probably got a little bit slower," he said. "There were a few balls where there was a fair bit of spin. A few went low. And I think with the new ball, you saw there was a little bit of movement around."

items.title: WHO unsure what caused pneumonia that killed plague-lab worker in Russia
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The World Health Organization said on Saturday that it still does not know what caused the pneumonia that killed a Russian lab worker at an anti-plague research center in Siberia this month, and that no case of plague had been registered.
items.body:
The World Health Organization said on Saturday that it still does not know what caused the pneumonia that killed a Russian lab worker at an anti-plague research center in Siberia this month, and that no case of plague had been registered.
The WHO said the Russian state regulator reported that tests of the lab worker and those who came in contact with her were negative for the high-threat pathogens tested, that her contacts still showed no symptoms, and that no further linked cases of severe pneumonia had been identified.
"Based on the information provided ... (the) WHO has not identified evidence of ongoing transmission associated with this event. A key uncertainty remains the absence of a confirmed diagnosis in the deceased laboratory worker," it said in a statement.
The lab worker [USN:L1N45S0CY TEXT:"fell ill"] and died in undisclosed circumstances on October 2, prompting authorities to quarantine about 200 people and causing public health fears on social media.
Global health officials have been extra alert to fatal pneumonia cases of undetermined cause since the COVID-19 pandemic, which began with a cluster of fast-spreading fatal respiratory illness in China. The cause of individual pneumonia cases can often not be determined.
Russian authorities have said the lab worker was appropriately vaccinated and that they found no microorganisms linked to her work in her body.
On Thursday, Russia said it had completed health checks on all the worker's contacts. It says it had provided full information to the WHO according to established procedures.

items.title: Pope Leo condemns death penalty as Trump mulls livestreamed execution
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Pope Leo renewed his condemnation of the death penalty on Saturday, saying it violates the sanctity of human life and deprives people of the chance of redemption, days after the Pentagon said it planned to livestream an execution.
items.body:
Pope Leo renewed his condemnation of the death penalty on Saturday, saying it violates the sanctity of human life and deprives people of the chance of redemption, days after the Pentagon said it planned to [USN:L1N45U124 TEXT:"livestream an execution"].
The US military will livestream the upcoming firing squad execution of a gunman who killed 13 people at the Fort Hood military base in 2009, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said on Thursday, in what would be an unprecedented broadcast of a US execution.
"The common good can be safeguarded and the requirements of justice can be met without recourse to capital punishment," Leo, the first pope from the United States, said in a social media post, without mentioning the Pentagon plan.
"The death penalty is inadmissible because it is an attack on the inviolability and dignity of the person," he added in the message posted on the World Day Against the Death Penalty.
Nidal Hasan, a former Army psychiatrist, is set to become the first person to be executed by firing squad by the US military since 1945.
The livestream plan, championed by Hegseth, has [USN:L6N45V11B TEXT:"drawn opposition"] from lawmakers, including from President Donald Trump's Republicans, religious leaders and international observers.
Trump himself has said he has not yet decided whether to allow the live feed, while Vice President JD Vance, who is a Catholic, expressed scepticism over whether the Pentagon would proceed with livestreaming the scheduled December 3 execution.
Vance also said he would not watch the livestream if it went ahead.
The execution plan comes amid heightened debate in the US over the death penalty following a [USN:L1N45S11A TEXT:"botched lethal injection"] of a Tennessee woman last week.

items.title: Ex-Virginia star Heidi Burge Horton dies from brain cancer
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Former Virginia standout and WNBA player Heidi Burge Horton died on Oct. 5 after battling brain cancer. She was 54.
items.body:
Former Virginia standout and WNBA player Heidi Burge Horton died on Oct. 5 after battling brain cancer. She was 54.
"We are deeply saddened by the passing of Heidi Burge Horton," the school posted this week. "Heidi was a cherished member of the Virginia Women's Basketball family, her legacy will forever be a part of Virginia Athletics. Our sincere condolences to her family and loved ones."
The 6-foot-5 Burge Horton played alongside her identical twin sister, Heather Burge, for four seasons and helped to establish the Cavaliers as a national powerhouse along with All-America teammate Dawn Staley.
"We are all heartbroken!" Staley, now the coach at South Carolina, posted on X. "We love you Heidi. May your soul rest in peace and your body pain free."
Virginia reached the Final Four in each of Burge Horton's first three seasons in 1989-90, 1990-91 and 1991-92, losing 70-67 to Tennessee in the 1991 national championship game in New Orleans.
Burge Horton averaged 8.9 points and 6.4 rebounds in 134 games with the Cavaliers from 1989-93 before playing overseas in France, Hungary, Italy and Greece.
The California native later played two seasons in the WNBA with the Los Angeles Sparks in the league's inaugural season in 1997 and with the expansion Washington Mystics in 1998, averaging 5.5 points and 3.3 rebounds in 52 games (21 starts).
The Disney Channel released a movie about the Burge twins called "Double Teamed" in 2002.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Canadiens trade D Jayden Struble to Predators for draft pick
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Nashville Predators acquired defenseman Jayden Struble from the Montreal Canadiens for a second-round pick in the 2027 NHL Draft.
items.body:
The Nashville Predators acquired defenseman Jayden Struble from the Montreal Canadiens for a second-round pick in the 2027 NHL Draft.
Struble, 25, played in three games this season for Montreal, averaging a career-low 12:05 of ice time with no points.
The Rhode Island native has 35 points (seven goals, 28 assists), a plus-3 rating and 167 penalty minutes in 174 games since making his NHL debut with the Canadiens in 2023. Montreal drafted Struble in the second round in 2019.
"Jayden Struble is a 25-year-old physical defender who will add mobility and a hard-to-play-against quality that will help our backend," said Chris MacFarland, the Predators' president of hockey operations and general manager, on Friday. "We are excited to watch his growth and look forward to him being a player who can grow with us."
Struble is in the second season of a two-year, $2.825 million contract he signed with the Canadiens on July 28, 2025.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Vários ficam feridos em explosão no aeroporto de Riad, segundo testemunhas
items.author: Timour Azhari, Enas Alashray
items.creator: Timour Azhari, Enas Alashray
items.summary: Muitas pessoas ficaram feridas em uma explosão no aeroporto internacional de Riad no sábado, segundo duas testemunhas oculares e duas pessoas a par do assunto, e os viajantes foram retirados de algumas áreas do local.
items.body:
Muitas pessoas ficaram feridas em uma explosão no aeroporto internacional de Riad no sábado, segundo duas testemunhas oculares e duas pessoas a par do assunto, e os viajantes foram retirados de algumas áreas do local.
Uma das testemunhas relatou ter visto uma explosão e, em seguida, várias pessoas feridas caídas no chão dentro do aeroporto. Mais de uma dezena de ambulâncias foram vistas se dirigindo às pressas para o aeroporto.
A assessoria de imprensa do governo saudita e a autoridade de aviação civil saudita não responderam imediatamente aos pedidos de comentários.
O incidente de sábado ocorre em meio a uma escalada de ataques com mísseis contra o reino por parte dos houthis do Iêmen, alinhados com o Irã. O aeroporto já havia sido atacado duas vezes nesta semana, deixando quatro mortos e outros feridos, além de causar graves danos a uma aeronave.
O site de rastreamento de voos flightradar24 mostrou que todos os voos com destino a Riad haviam sido desviados ou cancelados, com apenas um helicóptero sobrevoando o aeroporto em determinado momento.
O aeroporto pediu aos passageiros que entrassem em contato diretamente com suas companhias aéreas e verificassem o status de seus voos antes de se dirigirem ao local.
A Kuwait Airways informou ter cancelado voos de e para a capital saudita devido ao que descreveu como o fechamento do aeroporto de Riad por causa da “situação de segurança” no local.
A Etihad Airways e a Catar Airways já haviam cancelado vários voos entre seus respectivos hubs e Riad, com alguns cancelamentos se estendendo até segunda-feira.

items.title: L'Érythrée demande à l'Onu d'intervenir dans son conflit avec l'Éthiopie
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: L'Érythrée a demandé samedi au Conseil de sécurité de l'Onu de prendre des mesures dissuasives à l'encontre de l'Éthiopie, selon une lettre consultée par Reuters, faisant valoir que les accusations d'incursion formulées par Addis-Abeba à son encontre équivalaient à une "déclaration de guerre".
items.body:
L'Érythrée a demandé samedi au Conseil de sécurité de l'Onu de prendre des mesures dissuasives à l'encontre de l'Éthiopie, selon une lettre consultée par Reuters, faisant valoir que les accusations d'incursion formulées par Addis-Abeba à son encontre équivalaient à une "déclaration de guerre".
Cette incursion, démentie par l'Érythrée et que Reuters n'a pas pu vérifier de manière indépendante, fait craindre un retour à une guerre ouverte le long de la frontière nord de l'Éthiopie, où ces deux pays voisins de la Corne de l'Afrique se sont déjà affrontés par le passé.
Les conflits ailleurs dans la région et les tensions de l'autre côté de la mer Rouge accroissent encore les enjeux de ce conflit.
Le ministre érythréen des Affaires étrangères, Osman Saleh, a déclaré dans la lettre consultée par Reuters que les allégations d'incursion s'inscrivaient dans un plan éthiopien visant à justifier une guerre d'agression.
"L'Érythrée demande au Conseil de sécurité de l'Onu de condamner fermement la déplorable déclaration de guerre de l'Éthiopie contre l'Érythrée (...) et de prendre à son encontre les mesures dissuasives qui s'imposent, conformément au chapitre VII de la Charte des Nations unies", a-t-il écrit.
Le chapitre VII prévoit des mesures allant des sanctions à l'action militaire. Osman Saleh n'a pas précisé ce que réclame l'Érythrée.
L'Éthiopie a elle-même adressé vendredi un courrier aux membres du Conseil de sécurité en affirmant que les troupes érythréennes avaient progressé jusqu'à 60 km à l'intérieur de la région septentrionale du Tigré ces derniers jours et en avertissant que la présence de troupes étrangères ne lui laissait d'autre choix que de se défendre.
AFFRONTEMENTS PRÈS DE LA FRONTIÈRE Le porte-parole du Premier ministre éthiopien Abiy Ahmed n'a pas répondu dans l'immédiat à une demande de commentaire.
Plus tôt dans la journée, les forces gouvernementales éthiopiennes et les milices qui leur sont alliées sont entrées dans la ville tigréenne d'Adigrat près de la frontière avec l'Érythrée, selon trois habitants, quelques jours après que des troupes érythréennes ont été repoussées de cette ville stratégique.
Une vidéo diffusée sur les réseaux sociaux et vérifiée par Reuters montrait des membres d'une milice alliée au gouvernement éthiopien marchant dans les rues d'Adigrat, située à 30 km de la frontière avec l'Érythrée.
Trois habitants d'Adigrat ont également déclaré à Reuters avoir vu samedi matin l'armée éthiopienne et une milice alliée dans la ville. L'un d'eux a précisé avoir observé des soldats en patrouille accompagnés de véhicules militaires.
Des explosions ont été signalées mercredi et jeudi près d'Adigrat. Selon l'observatoire américain ACLED, l'Éthiopie aurait mené des frappes de drones contre les forces érythréennes, qui se sont ensuite retirées de leurs positions près de la ville.
L'ENJEU DE L'ACCÈS À LA MER Les explosions se sont poursuivies vendredi, selon un habitant d'Adigrat, qui a déclaré à Reuters avoir entendu des détonations répétées pendant la nuit et jusqu'au matin, à plusieurs kilomètres de la ville.
Le ministre érythréen de l'Information, Yemane Gebremeskel, a déclaré vendredi que son pays avait fait preuve de retenue et qu'une affirmation formulée en 2023 par l'Éthiopie, pays enclavé, selon laquelle elle obtiendrait un accès souverain à la mer, équivalait à une déclaration de guerre d'agression contre son pays.
L'Éthiopie a disposé d'un accès à la mer pendant des décennies jusqu'à l'indépendance de l'Érythrée vis-à-vis d'Addis-Abeba en 1993. L'Éthiopie estime que le rétablissement de cet accès constitue une question existentielle, tout en affirmant vouloir y parvenir par la paix et le dialogue.
Addis-Abeba accuse en outre l'Érythrée de soutenir l'alliance rebelle qui combat les forces gouvernementales depuis le 23 septembre dans les régions septentrionales du Tigré, de l'Amhara et de l'Afar. L'Érythrée rejette ces accusations.
Après des années de conflit, les deux pays avaient conclu la paix dans le cadre d'un accord datant de 2018 qui avait valu à Abiy Ahmed le prix Nobel de la paix. L'Érythrée avait soutenu le gouvernement fédéral éthiopien durant la guerre civile du Tigré de 2020 à 2022, mais les relations entre les deux pays se sont de nouveau détériorées vers la fin du conflit.
Les combats qui ont éclaté le mois dernier constituent la plus grave escalade de violence depuis la guerre du Tigré, qui a fait des centaines de milliers de morts.
items.raw_description: L'Érythrée a demandé samedi au Conseil de sécurité de l'Onu de prendre des mesures dissuasives à l'encontre de l'Éthiopie, selon une lettre consultée par Reuters, faisant valoir que les accusations d'incursion formulées par Addis-Abeba à son encontre équivalaient à une "déclaration de guerre".

items.title: Furacão Isaias deixa 2 mortos e milhares sem energia elétrica nos EUA
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Duas pessoas morreram e cerca de 800 mil moradores da Flórida, do Alabama e da Geórgia ficaram sem energia elétrica depois que o furacão Isaias atingiu o continente na madrugada deste sábado, enfraquecendo-se e se transformando em um ciclone pós-tropical, segundo autoridades locais e serviços de monitoramento de energia elétrica.
items.body:
Duas pessoas morreram e cerca de 800 mil moradores da Flórida, do Alabama e da Geórgia ficaram sem energia elétrica depois que o furacão Isaias atingiu o continente na madrugada deste sábado, enfraquecendo-se e se transformando em um ciclone pós-tropical, segundo autoridades locais e serviços de monitoramento de energia elétrica.
As autoridades da Flórida não receberam nenhum pedido de busca e resgate logo após a chegada do furacão, o que indica um impacto limitado, afirmou o governador Ron DeSantis. No entanto, as condições de risco persistiam e eram esperadas ondas de tempestade, enchentes repentinas, ventos destrutivos e risco de tornados em partes do sudeste dos EUA, informou o Centro Nacional de Furacões (NHC).
A ameaça de tornados deve continuar no sábado em partes do Panhandle da Flórida, na Geórgia e nas Carolinas, informou o NHC.
Na Flórida, o restabelecimento da energia elétrica foi definido como prioridade, segundo as autoridades, enquanto rodovias, pontes e aeroportos estavam sendo reabertos e equipes avaliavam os danos.
“Eles farão avaliações nesta manhã, e acho que isso nos dará uma boa noção sobre a rapidez com que a energia será restaurada”, disse DeSantis em uma coletiva de imprensa em Tallahassee. Cerca de 16 mil técnicos de energia elétrica se prepararam para responder à tempestade, afirmou ele.
Mais de 430 mil consumidores na Flórida, mais de 280 mil no Alabama e cerca de 100 mil na Geórgia ficaram sem energia elétrica quando a tempestade atingiu a costa, de acordo com a empresa de monitoramento PowerOutage.us.
No Alabama e na Flórida, duas pessoas morreram devido à queda de árvores, segundo a mídia local e as autoridades. A agência de gestão de emergências do Alabama informou que as árvores e linhas de energia caídas tornaram o tráfego perigoso no condado de Houston, que está sob alerta de enchentes repentinas.
“Devido aos impactos do furacão Isaias, todas as estradas do condado de Houston estão fechadas até novo aviso”, informou a agência no X.
Isaias perdeu rapidamente a velocidade do vento após atingir a costa da Flórida como um furacão de categoria 2, o primeiro da temporada atlântica de 2026.

items.title: Man dies after entering tiger enclosure at British zoo
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: British police said a man died on Saturday after he entered a tiger enclosure at the Yorkshire Wildlife Park and was attacked.
items.body:
British police said a man died on Saturday after he entered a tiger enclosure at the Yorkshire Wildlife Park and was attacked.
South Yorkshire Police said officers had been called to the zoo following reports a man had entered the enclosure, adding that there was no wider risk to the public.
"The man's family is aware and is being supported by specialist officers. Our thoughts are with them at this distressing time," the police said in a statement.
Yorkshire Wildlife Park said it had closed after a "serious incident" involving the tiger enclosure and was working with authorities to ascertain what had happened. The zoo will remain closed until Sunday, it added.
"The safety and wellbeing of our visitors, staff and animals remain our highest priority," it said in a statement on its website.

items.title: Brommapojkarna edge AIK 6-5 in Swedish thriller
items.author: Philip O'connor
items.creator: Philip O'connor
items.summary: A goal from Mads Hansen in the ninth minute of stoppage time gave Brommapojkarna a sensational 6-5 victory over AIK in Sweden's Allsvenskan on Saturday as AIK came back from 5-1 down, only to lose with virtually the last kick of the game.
items.body:
A goal from Mads Hansen in the ninth minute of stoppage time gave Brommapojkarna a sensational 6-5 victory over AIK in Sweden's Allsvenskan on Saturday as AIK came back from 5-1 down, only to lose with virtually the last kick of the game.
After a goalless first half between the Stockholm sides, BP took the lead through Simon Strand in the 46th minute and Abdihakim Ali equalised before the game exploded into chaos, with BP netting four goals in 12 minutes to race into a 5-1 wlead ith 20 minutes to play.
Incredibly, AIK came back with four unanswered goals of their own, Johan Hove netting in the seventh minute of stoppage time to make it 5-5, but Hansen scored from close range two minutes later to give BP their first league win over AIK at the 20th attempt.
"It was value for money for those who came here today," a beaming Strand told broadcaster TV4.
"It was a fun game up to 5-1, and then it was an uphill battle. But no, it was really fun, completely blown away after a match like this, to be honest," he added.
AIK are ninth in the 16-team standings on 33 points, 21 points behind leaders Sirius. BP are 11th on 30 points.

items.title: Abbas adia eleições palestinas e marca pleito presidencial para setembro de 2027
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O presidente palestino Mahmoud Abbas adiou neste sábado as eleições legislativas previstas para o próximo mês até 11 de setembro de 2027 e convocou uma eleição presidencial para a mesma data, atribuindo a culpa pelo adiamento a Israel e à situação de segurança nos territórios palestinos.
items.body:
O presidente palestino Mahmoud Abbas adiou neste sábado as eleições legislativas previstas para o próximo mês até 11 de setembro de 2027 e convocou uma eleição presidencial para a mesma data, atribuindo a culpa pelo adiamento a Israel e à situação de segurança nos territórios palestinos.
O decreto de Abbas citou “obstáculos impostos por medidas israelenses” e a necessidade de estabelecer condições políticas, de segurança e no terreno adequadas para “eleições livres, justas e inclusivas”, informou a agência oficial de notícias palestina WAFA.
O decreto convocou os palestinos em Jerusalém, na Cisjordânia e em Gaza a votar.
Havia sérias dúvidas de que a votação da Autoridade Palestina fosse ocorrer no mês que vem. Os palestinos não realizam eleições legislativas ou presidenciais desde 2005-06, período após o qual o rival de Abbas, o grupo islâmico Hamas, assumiu o controle de Gaza, destituindo seus partidários.
Abbas tem governado por decreto desde que seu mandato presidencial expirou em 2009.
A Autoridade Palestina realizou eleições municipais em abril na Cisjordânia e em Deir al-Balah, no centro de Gaza, a única cidade do enclave que participou. A votação foi a primeira eleição realizada em Gaza desde 2006.
Segundo o decreto, os ataques militares israelenses, a expansão dos assentamentos, a violência dos colonos e as restrições de circulação na Cisjordânia, incluindo Jerusalém Oriental, juntamente com a retenção contínua por parte de Israel das receitas tributárias palestinas, criaram desafios para a preparação e a realização das eleições em novembro deste ano.
Em Gaza, o decreto apontou para “condições excepcionais de segurança e humanitárias”, a retirada incompleta das forças israelenses, a falta de progresso na reconstrução e o fracasso na implementação de acordos para o envio de forças internacionais de estabilização e da polícia.
As restrições israelenses ao acesso de funcionários da comissão eleitoral e observadores internacionais a Gaza e Jerusalém Oriental também complicaram os preparativos, segundo o decreto.
Não houve comentário imediato de Israel sobre o anúncio de Abbas, com autoridades indisponíveis para comentar no sábado, o sabá judaico. Israel normalmente proíbe a Autoridade Palestina de realizar eleições em Jerusalém Oriental, território que conquistou na guerra de 1967 e posteriormente anexou, em uma medida que a maioria dos países não reconhece.

items.title: French prodigy Seixas wins Giro di Lombardia, his first Monument
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: French prodigy Paul Seixas rode solo to claim the first Monument victory of his career at the Giro di Lombardia on Saturday, ahead of Spain's Enric Mas and Italy's Giulio Ciccone.
items.body:
French prodigy Paul Seixas rode solo to claim the first Monument victory of his career at the Giro di Lombardia on Saturday, ahead of Spain's Enric Mas and Italy's Giulio Ciccone.
The 20-year-old attacked 19 km from the finish in Como (Italy) to claim the title won by Tadej Pogacar for the last five years. The Slovenian missed the race after crashing at the Vuelta a Espana two months ago.
Seixas won his first Monument — one of the five most prestigious one-day races in professional cycling — in his third appearance. He finished seventh in this race last year and second behind Pogacar at the last Liege–Bastogne–Liege.
"It's crazy, it feels like a dream," Seixas said. "Everything went perfect. I had amazing legs, I had the feeling that today was a great day and I managed to make the difference at the moment I choose."
Seixas, who finished fourth in this year's Tour de France, pulled clear on the Civiglio climb with 19 km to go. Britain's Tom Pidcock and Ciccone were the only riders able to follow his wheel.
The Frenchman dropped both rivals a few hundred metres later and rode alone over the final 18 km to become the youngest Monument winner since 1944 and youngest ever winner of the Giro di Lombardia.
SEIXAS ENDS FRENCH WAIT The Decathlon–CMA CGM rider is the first Frenchman to win a Monument since Julian Alaphilippe at Milan–San Remo in 2019, and the first to triumph at the Giro di Lombardia since Thibaut Pinot in 2018.
The victory came two weeks after a huge disappointment for Seixas at the World Championships, where he finished 15th after starting among the favourites.
"After the championship, I moved on to other things; I trained hard to get here," Seixas said. "It’s incredible."
The 239 km ride from Bergamo to Como began with a [USN:L6N45W026 TEXT:"five-minute protest"] in the peloton to highlight growing safety concerns following a series of incidents involving race vehicles.
After organisers completed the start countdown, the peloton remained stationary, before double Olympic champion Remco Evenepoel stepped forward to explain the riders' action.
The protest came days after riders Thomas Gloag and Marcel Camprubi were struck by a police motorcycle during Tre Valli Varesine. Britain's Finlay Tarling was killed in a collision with a vehicle during the Tour of Portugal in August.

items.title: Cyclisme-Seixas remporte le Tour de Lombardie, son premier monument
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Paul Seixas (Decathlon-CMA CGM) a remporté samedi le premier monument du cyclisme de sa jeune carrière en triomphant sur le Tour de Lombardie, dont il est devenu le plus jeune vainqueur de l'histoire devant l'Espagnol Enric Mas (Movistar) et l'Italien Giulio Ciccone (Lidl-Trek).
items.body:
Paul Seixas (Decathlon-CMA CGM) a remporté samedi le premier monument du cyclisme de sa jeune carrière en triomphant sur le Tour de Lombardie, dont il est devenu le plus jeune vainqueur de l'histoire devant l'Espagnol Enric Mas (Movistar) et l'Italien Giulio Ciccone (Lidl-Trek).
Le Français de tout juste 20 ans succède au palmarès au Slovène Tadej Pogacar, quintuple vainqueur sortant et absent sur les bords du lac de Côme (Italie) après sa chute sur le dernier Tour d'Espagne.
Le quatrième du dernier Tour de France est le premier Tricolore à lever les bras sur un monument - les cinq courses d'un jour les plus prestigieuses - depuis Julian Alaphilippe en 2019 sur Milan-San Remo et le premier à s'imposer sur le Tour de Lombardie depuis Thibaut Pinot en 2018.
Paul Seixas devient également le plus jeune vainqueur d'un monument depuis 1944.
"C'est fou, c'est comme dans un rêve", a-t-il réagi, incrédule.
"Je ne réalise pas. Tout s'est déroulé parfaitement. J'avais des jambes incroyables et le sentiment qu'aujourd'hui était un grand jour. J'ai réussi à faire la différence au moment que j'avais choisi."
Paul Seixas a une nouvelle fois démontré qu'il était l'un des coureurs les plus talentueux du peloton malgré son jeune âge. Il s'est imposé samedi dès sa troisième participation à un monument, après sa septième place ici-même l'an passé et sa deuxième place de Liège-Bastogne-Liège, en avril, derrière l'ogre Tadej Pogacar.
En l'absence du double champion du monde, le coureur de l'équipe Decathlon-CMA CGM n'a pas loupé le coche. Il a accéléré dans l'ascension du Civiglio, à 19 km de l'arrivée.
Seuls le Britannique Tom Pidcock et Giulio Ciccone ont d'abord réussi à prendre sa roue, avant de craquer quelques centaines de mètres plus loin. Paul Seixas a ainsi filé vers la victoire en solitaire, résistant à ses poursuivants pendant les 18 derniers kilomètres.
Le vainqueur de La Flèche wallonne, en avril, a parfaitement rebondi après son immense déception des Mondiaux, où il avait terminé 15e deux semaines plus tôt malgré son statut de favori aux côtés de Remco Evenepoel ou d'Isaac del Toro. Le Belge et le Mexicain ont respectivement terminé quatrième et 28e samedi.
"Après le championnat, je suis passé à autre chose, je me suis entraîné dur pour arriver ici", a expliqué Paul Seixas. "C'est incroyable."
items.raw_description: Paul Seixas (Decathlon-CMA CGM) a remporté samedi le premier monument du cyclisme de sa jeune carrière en triomphant sur le Tour de Lombardie, dont il est devenu le plus jeune vainqueur de l'histoire devant l'Espagnol Enric Mas (Movistar) et l'Italien Giulio Ciccone (Lidl-Trek).

items.title: Ataque russo mata 20 na Ucrânia um dia após Trump ter flexibilizado sanções contra Moscou sobre diesel
items.author: Sergiy Chalyi, Max Hunder
items.creator: Sergiy Chalyi, Max Hunder
items.summary: Vinte pessoas, incluindo três crianças, morreram em um ataque russo à cidade de Zaporizhzhia, no sul da Ucrânia, no sábado, um dia depois que o presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, anunciou um acordo para suspender as sanções contra o diesel russo — um grande revés para Kiev.
items.body:
Vinte pessoas, incluindo três crianças, morreram em um ataque russo à cidade de Zaporizhzhia, no sul da Ucrânia, no sábado, um dia depois que o presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, anunciou um acordo para suspender as sanções contra o diesel russo — um grande revés para Kiev.
Uma menina de seis anos estava entre as vítimas fatais quando um ataque reduziu parte de um prédio de apartamentos a escombros. Seu avô chorava ao lado do corpo dela, deitado no chão dentro de um saco branco, depois que as equipes de resgate o retiraram dos escombros.
“Hoje, a Rússia agradeceu pelo levantamento das sanções às exportações de diesel lançando cinco bombas planadoras sobre prédios residenciais em Zaporizhzhia”, disse o presidente Volodymyr Zelenskiy, em uma de suas críticas mais contundentes até agora à Casa Branca.
Outras 18 pessoas ficaram feridas no ataque a Zaporizhzhia, uma cidade industrial cujos arredores ficam a menos de 30 km da linha de frente.
O bombardeio foi o mais recente de uma série de ataques que causaram um grande número de vítimas em toda a Ucrânia. Quase 80 civis foram mortos em ataques russos ao longo de dois dias nesta semana.
“O aniversário dela seria no final do mês”, disse Anatoliy Chumniy, avô da menina de seis anos, entre lágrimas.
O governador local, Mykhailo Semikin, disse que a Rússia atacou vários locais simultaneamente nas primeiras horas deste sábado.
Equipes de resgate escalaram os escombros para retirar com vida outros moradores do prédio. Um homem, cuja perna estava presa nos escombros, gritava de dor enquanto era resgatado.
Zaporizhzhia, com uma população pré-guerra de mais de 700 mil habitantes, tem sido alvo constante de bombardeios russos, com ataques que se intensificaram nos últimos meses.
“A noite passada foi mais uma confirmação de que a Rússia interpreta qualquer diminuição da pressão como um sinal de que pode, supostamente, continuar lutando, de que pode, supostamente, continuar lançando bombas sobre as cidades. São necessários sinais diferentes”, declarou Zelenskiy.
TRUMP SUSPENDE SANÇÕES AO DIESEL A decisão de Trump de suspender as sanções às exportações russas de diesel ocorre no momento em que seu governo busca conter os preços dos combustíveis, que subiram acentuadamente durante o conflito dos EUA com o Irã.
Kiev, por sua vez, havia instado Washington a aumentar a pressão sobre Moscou, em um esforço para forçá-la a entrar em negociações sérias para pôr fim à guerra que já dura quatro anos e meio.
Trump, por sua vez, criticou os ataques ucranianos a refinarias de petróleo russas, que, segundo ele, elevaram os preços globais. Kiev afirmou que deseja a suspensão total de todos os ataques a instalações energéticas por ambos os lados, enquanto Moscou ataca a rede elétrica da Ucrânia.
No sábado, partes de Kiev e da região circundante ficaram sem energia elétrica, levando os trens do metrô da cidade a uma paralisação total pela segunda vez nesta semana.
Os últimos ataques ocorreram depois que autoridades ucranianas e europeias mantiveram conversações com negociadores dos EUA em Miami na sexta-feira, com o objetivo de elaborar uma proposta comum para pôr fim à guerra, segundo uma pessoa a par das discussões.
Trump anunciou o acordo sobre o diesel enquanto as negociações estavam em andamento, uma medida que, segundo Zelenskiy, pegou Kiev de surpresa.
O presidente russo, Vladimir Putin, disse após uma ligação com Trump que era improvável uma retomada imediata das negociações de paz, citando ataques com drones ucranianos a Moscou.
Quatro civis foram mortos e outros cinco ficaram feridos em consequência dos ataques ucranianos à região de Luhansk, controlada pela Rússia, no leste da Ucrânia, afirmou no sábado o governador nomeado pela Rússia.
A Reuters não conseguiu verificar a informação de forma independente e não houve comentário imediato da Ucrânia.

items.title: Red Bull's Verstappen fastest in Singapore to claim 50th career pole
items.author: Rohith Nair
items.creator: Rohith Nair
items.summary: He repeated his heroics from the sprint qualifying session a day earlier.
items.body:
Red Bull's Max Verstappen claimed the 50th pole position of his career when he went fastest in qualifying under the lights at the Singapore Grand Prix on Saturday, repeating his heroics from the sprint qualifying session a day earlier.
Verstappen clocked one minute 31.373 seconds at the Marina Bay Street Circuit and will have Ferrari's Charles Leclerc alongside him on the front row, with the Monegasque driver just 0.054 seconds slower than the four-times champion.
Leclerc's team mate Lewis Hamilton was third fastest and championship leader Kimi Antonelli was fourth quickest for Mercedes.
"The margins are very close between us throughout all of qualifying, so of course, very happy to be on pole because this is the one that I wanted," Verstappen said ahead of his 250th race.
"The car has been pretty strong all weekend. Of course, I always think that you can be better, but it was enough for pole, so very happy with that."
Verstappen, who [USN:L1N45W02M TEXT:"won a chaotic sprint"] in wet conditions earlier on Saturday, topped the timesheets despite gearbox issues in Q2 to claim his second straight pole of the season.
Leclerc had struggled in Q1 and Q2 but found his groove in Q3 to put Ferrari on the front row right at the end of the session.
"I had some weird things going on with the brakes, car pulling a bit under braking, which is not so nice on a track like here," Leclerc said.
"But then in Q3, the lap was okay. I did some mistakes. I think there was a potential to be on pole today, but Max just did a better job."
With celebrity girlfriend Kim Kardashian watching on from the Ferrari garage, Hamilton topped Q1 and Q2 at a circuit where he has four victories, but the Briton could not reproduce his form in Q3.
"There's a real fine line with our car where it's over the edge or under the limit and finding that sweet spot is very, very difficult," said seven-times world champion Hamilton.
Mercedes driver George Russell, second in the championship, was sixth fastest in Q3 but the Briton is set to start from the back of the grid due to his engine penalty as he looks to bridge the 89-point gap to Antonelli.
HADJAR LOSES 100% Q3 RECORD Drivers struggled under braking in the first session, with Esteban Ocon and Lance Stroll both forced to abandon their laps, but the biggest casualty of Q1 was Verstappen's team mate Isack Hadjar.
The Frenchman complained about an issue with his gearbox before the 22-year-old returned to the garage without setting a lap time, losing his 100% record of qualifying for Q3 this year.
"Nothing Isack could have done. We had a gearbox issue on his car," Red Bull team principal Laurent Mekies told Sky Sports.
Verstappen also complained about gearbox issues despite advancing from Q2.
"Insanely, insanely bad shifts," he said. "The downshifts are so bad."
Reigning champion Lando Norris and McLaren team mate Oscar Piastri will line up on the third row after the stewards took no further action following the collision between the two drivers in the sprint.
Alpine's Pierre Gasly will start seventh on the grid followed by the Racing Bulls of Liam Lawson and Arvid Lindblad, and Audi's Nico Hulkenberg completed the top 10.

items.title: Autoridad saudita reporta varios heridos por explosión en aeropuerto de Riad
items.author: Timour Azhari, Enas Alashray
items.creator: Timour Azhari, Enas Alashray
items.summary: Varias personas resultaron heridas en un ataque perpetrado el sábado contra el Aeropuerto Internacional Rey Khalid, en Riad, la capital de Arabia Saudita, lo que obligó a suspender las operaciones, informó la autoridad de aviación civil del país.
items.body:
Varias personas resultaron heridas en un ataque perpetrado el sábado contra el Aeropuerto Internacional Rey Khalid, en Riad, la capital de Arabia Saudita, lo que obligó a suspender las operaciones, informó la autoridad de aviación civil del país.
Nadie ha reivindicado de momento la autoría del ataque, pero ocurre en el contexto de una escalada de ataques con misiles contra el reino por parte de los hutíes yemeníes, alineados con Irán, y sigue a otros esta semana contra el aeropuerto de Riad, en los que murieron cuatro personas, varias resultaron heridas y se dañó un avión.
El sistema de alerta temprana de Arabia Saudita no emitió ninguna alerta antes del incidente del sábado.
La oficina de prensa del Gobierno saudita no respondió de inmediato a las solicitudes de comentarios.
Uno de los testigos presenciales dijo haber visto una explosión y, a continuación, varias personas heridas tendidas en el suelo dentro del aeropuerto. Más de una decena de ambulancias se dirigieron a toda prisa hacia el aeropuerto.
Un viajero herido contó a Reuters que vio algo volando por el cielo fuera del aeropuerto antes de que se derrumbara parte del techo cerca de una puerta de embarque.
Tras el ataque, se le preguntó al presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, si Estados Unidos tenía previsto sumarse a los ataques sauditas contra los hutíes.
"Es posible. Lo vamos a estudiar. Acabamos de enterarnos del reciente ataque, así que tomaremos una decisión. Actuamos con gran rapidez", dijo.
La página web de seguimiento de vuelos flightradar24 mostraba que todos los vuelos con destino a Riad habían sido desviados o cancelados, y que, en un momento dado, solo un helicóptero sobrevolaba el aeropuerto.

items.title: Arteta's Arsenal survive scare to see off feisty Leeds
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Mikel Arteta's Arsenal were staring down the barrel of a second straight Premier League defeat when they fell behind to Leeds United at home on Saturday, but tactical tweaks and inspired substitutions helped them bounce back to claim a 2-1 victory.
items.body:
Mikel Arteta's Arsenal were staring down the barrel of a second straight Premier League defeat when they fell behind to Leeds United at home on Saturday, but tactical tweaks and inspired substitutions helped them bounce back to claim a 2-1 victory.
After frustrating the champions during the opening 45 minutes with stifling defending, Leeds took the lead through James Justin 10 minutes after the break, but Riccardo Calafiori equalised for Arteta's side before substitute Bruno Guimaraes grabbed the winner in the 70th minute.
"They are extremely well-organised, they are very physical, they are committed in everything that they do," Arteta told TNT Sports.
Arsenal's last game before the lengthy international window ended in an embarrassing 3-0 defeat by Brighton & Hove Albion, and it looked like they might be frustrated again as their attacking play stuttered.
"When you don't finish the actions, and we hit some great areas in the first half to have much more end product than we did, and we lost the ball just before the last action, and when that happens and they had moments to run, they are a threat," Arteta explained.
"We keep fouling them, we give them throw-ins and restarts and set pieces. They are incredible the way they attack, the belief and the conviction they have to attack the box."
Leeds came into Saturday's clash unbeaten in the league, but Calafiori's goal seemed to knock the wind out of their sails, and the introduction of Guimaraes in a triple substitution with Jurrien Timber and Viktor Gyokeres in the 63rd minute proved the turning point.
"We bring a lot of leadership in those three players - we brought a goal threat, we brought people who can win duels because it was very man-orientated, people that can get away from that, people that can play forward and penetrate. Against this high press, and they did an incredible job," Arteta said.
With many of his players on international duty in recent weeks, Arteta has had to wait a long time to banish the memory of the Brighton defeat.
"Immediately after a bad result, and through weeks without your players, you just question, 'Okay, how are we going to be?'," he said. "We reacted incredibly well. We really need to enjoy the victory, because we are realising how this Premier League is going to pan out."

items.title: Abbas aplaza las elecciones palestinas y fija las presidenciales para septiembre de 2027
items.author: Ali Sawafta, Nidal Al-Mughrabi, Eman Abouhassira
items.creator: Ali Sawafta, Nidal Al-Mughrabi, Eman Abouhassira
items.summary: El presidente palestino, Mahmud Abás, aplazó el sábado las elecciones legislativas previstas para el próximo mes hasta el 11 de septiembre de 2027 y convocó unas elecciones presidenciales para esa misma fecha, achacando el retraso a Israel y a la situación de seguridad en los territorios palestinos.
items.body:
El presidente palestino, Mahmud Abás, aplazó el sábado las elecciones legislativas previstas para el próximo mes hasta el 11 de septiembre de 2027 y convocó unas elecciones presidenciales para esa misma fecha, achacando el retraso a Israel y a la situación de seguridad en los territorios palestinos.
El decreto de Abbas citaba "los obstáculos que plantean las medidas israelíes" y la necesidad de establecer unas condiciones políticas, de seguridad y sobre el terreno adecuadas para celebrar "elecciones libres, justas e inclusivas", informó la agencia oficial de noticias palestina WAFA.
El decreto instaba a los palestinos de Jerusalén, Cisjordania y Gaza a acudir a las urnas.
Existían serias dudas sobre si las elecciones de la Autoridad Palestina se celebrarían el próximo mes.
Los palestinos no han celebrado elecciones legislativas ni presidenciales desde 2005-2006, tras lo cual el rival de Abbas, el grupo islamista Hamás, tomó el control de Gaza, derrocando a sus partidarios.
Abbas ha gobernado por decreto desde que expiró su mandato presidencial en 2009.
El decreto señaló que los ataques militares israelíes, la expansión de los asentamientos, la violencia de los colonos y las restricciones de movimiento en Cisjordania, incluido Jerusalén Este, junto con la continua retención por parte de Israel de los ingresos fiscales palestinos, planteaban dificultades para la preparación y celebración de las elecciones de noviembre.
En Gaza, el decreto señalaba las "condiciones humanitarias y de seguridad excepcionales", la retirada incompleta de las fuerzas israelíes, la falta de avances en la reconstrucción y el incumplimiento de los acuerdos para el despliegue de fuerzas internacionales de estabilización y de policía.
Las restricciones israelíes al acceso del personal de la comisión electoral y de los observadores internacionales a Gaza y Jerusalén Este también complicaron los preparativos, según el decreto.
La decisión de aplazar las elecciones se tomó tras consultar con las facciones y fuerzas políticas palestinas. También tenía por objeto dar tiempo para que se lleve a cabo un diálogo nacional palestino exhaustivo con el fin de reforzar la unidad y abordar los retos a los que se enfrenta el proceso electoral.
Dos responsables palestinos dijeron el jueves a Reuters que los líderes del movimiento Fatah, de Abbas, y de su rival Hamás habían acordado en una reunión el miércoles en El Cairo aplazar las elecciones.
COMPROMISO CON ELECCIONES El aplazamiento se anuncia apenas unas semanas después de que Abbas reafirmó el calendario electoral de noviembre en su discurso del 24 de septiembre ante la Asamblea General de la ONU, en un intento por impulsar reformas respaldadas internacionalmente.
Abbas se había comprometido por escrito con el presidente francés Emmanuel Macron y con el príncipe heredero saudí Mohammed bin Salman a celebrar elecciones presidenciales y legislativas como parte del reconocimiento por parte de Francia de un Estado palestino en septiembre de 2025.
El Ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores francés dijo el jueves que la celebración de las elecciones era esencial y acogió con satisfacción la puesta en marcha de una misión de observación electoral de la UE.

items.title: Augsburg score fastest Bundesliga goal but Bayern snatch comeback draw
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Augsburg's Robin Fellhauer scored after eight seconds of the game against visitors Bayern Munich on Saturday to record the fastest goal in Bundesliga history, but the German champions twice came from a goal down to snatch a 2-2 draw.
items.body:
Augsburg's Robin Fellhauer scored after eight seconds of the game against visitors Bayern Munich on Saturday to record the fastest goal in Bundesliga history, but the German champions twice came from a goal down to snatch a 2-2 draw.
Fellhauer benefited from a blunder by Bayern's Manuel Neuer as the keeper tried to clear but sent the ball to the Augsburg player who improved the record held jointly by Kevin Volland and Karim Bellarabi with goals after nine seconds.
The Bavarians, whose only league defeat in their last 48 matches was by Augsburg in January, upped their game after the break, having an effort ruled offside in the 51st before Ismael Saibari bagged the equaliser four minutes later.
It was another Neuer error that put Augsburg ahead again in the 64th minute, the 40-year-old punching Calvin Brackelmann's shot into the path of Rodrigo Ribeiro who only had to push the ball over the line.
Bayern battled back once more, however, when Harry Kane, who hit the woodwork in the first half, cut the ball back for Nathaniel Brown to tap in the equaliser 10 minutes from time.
Gnabry hit the post three minutes but Bayern had to settle for a point and second place on 11. Borussia Dortmund are top on 13 points.

It was another Neuer error that put Augsburg ahead again in the 64th minute, the 40-year-old punching Calvin Brackelmann's shot into the path of Rodrigo Ribeiro who only had to push the ball over the line.
Bayern battled back once more, however, when Harry Kane, who hit the woodwork in the first half, cut the ball back for Nathaniel Brown to tap in the equaliser 10 minutes from time.
Gnabry hit the post three minutes but Bayern had to settle for a point and second place on 11. Borussia Dortmund are top on 13 points.

items.title: Three injured in Poland's third youth stabbing attack in four days
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Three people were injured in a stabbing attack at a further education college in Warsaw on Saturday, police said, the latest in a series of incidents that have stoked concerns in Poland about copycat violence among young people.
items.body:
Three people were injured in a stabbing attack at a further education college in Warsaw on Saturday, police said, the latest in a series of incidents that have stoked concerns in Poland about copycat violence among young people.
On Friday [USN:L1N45V0E9 TEXT:"thousands of police"] visited schools nationwide to try to reassure pupils after two stabbing sprees by teenagers in as many days sparked rumours of potential further attacks, fears that Saturday's incident is likely to intensify.
"At 12:30 today, we received a report of an incident involving the use of a dangerous weapon," police spokesperson Jakub Filipiak told Reuters.
"One person was injured and transported to the hospital with non-life-threatening injuries. Two other bystanders also sustained injuries but did not require hospitalisation."
He said the attacker was a 21-year-old student of the college.
State news agency PAP reported that the victims were two 17-year-old girls and a 24-year-old woman who had come to submit enrollment documents. Preliminary police findings indicated that the attacker and victims did not know one other, PAP reported.
Police said on Saturday they had inspected some 50,000 facilities since Friday and detained 76 people. Authorities had previously said most of the people detained were teenagers who had made threats online.
On Thursday, a 15-year-old former pupil wearing a helmet-mounted camera [USN:L8N45U0GO TEXT:"killed a caretaker"] and injured two teachers at a primary school in Leszczydol-Nowiny, northeast of Warsaw. On Wednesday, a 19-year-old [USN:L1N45T0N9 TEXT:"wounded 10 people"] including himself at a school in Ostroleka, north of the capital.
