items.title: Hastings like a local
items.author: Alexandra Hudson
items.creator: Alexandra Hudson
items.summary: Our desk editor’s guide to castle views, shipwrecks and seasonal festivals.
items.body:
REUTERS/Illustration/Kate Evans Famous for the eponymous battle of 1066 that inspired the Bayeux Tapestry , the British seaside town of Hastings — my home of the last decade — has a thriving cultural life, magnificent natural setting and rough-around-the-edges charm that grows on you quickly.
The beach is the star attraction, atmospheric pubs and cafes abound, and of course there are Hastings' evocative historical sites — not least the ruined Hastings Castle , constructed by William, Duke of Normandy, after winning the English throne.
I grew up in Brighton, also on the country's southern coast, and settled in Hastings with my family after postings in Berlin, Amsterdam, and Istanbul for Reuters. The sea air and screeching seagulls made it quickly feel like home. Hastings is not immune to the problems affecting Britain's coastal towns, including a lack of employment and some deprivation, and it has seen its fortunes rise and fall over the decades. But the town is drawing more visitors and blossoming with fresh energy and new ventures.
Here is how to visit Hastings like a local:
Getting around: Hastings and neighbouring St Leonards-on-Sea, once a Regency-era resort and now the edgier of the two, form one urban area that is best explored on foot. Walking from central St Leonards to Hastings along the seafront promenade takes less than one hour. The elegant apartment blocks give way to British seaside staples like mini golf, go-karts and amusement arcades before you reach the Old Town, with its compact streets of timbered houses.
People relax at Goat Ledge beach cafe at St Leonards-on-Sea, next to Hastings, Britain, October 4, 2026. REUTERS/Toby Melville People relax at a cafe on West Hill in Hastings Old Town, Hastings, Britain, October 4, 2026. REUTERS/Toby Melville A person views Hastings Old Town and Hastings beach as they travel on the funicular railway on East Hill. REUTERS/Toby Melville A view of Battle Abbey, built on the site of the Battle of Hastings in 1066, in Battle. REUTERS/Toby Melville A view of Battle Abbey, through a tower window, which was built on the site of the Battle of Hastings in 1066, in Battle. REUTERS/Toby Melville People relax among the remains of Hastings Castle, built in 1066 by William the Conqueror. REUTERS/Toby Melville A fisherman throws equipment from a boat after returning from a fishing trip in The Stade area of Hastings Old Town. Hastings has one of the largest working beach-launched fishing fleets in Europe. REUTERS/Toby Melville A person fishes off the harbour wall in Hastings Old Town. REUTERS/Toby Melville People walk on Hastings Pier, styled on the deck of an ocean liner. REUTERS/Toby Melville Hastings Old Town, Hastings Pier and Hastings beach are viewed from East Hill. REUTERS/Toby Melville People walk past Hastings Contemporary art gallery in Hastings Old Town. REUTERS/Toby Melville A drone view shows the beach and seafront at Hastings and St Leonards-on-Sea. REUTERS/Toby Melville People walk through George Street in Hastings Old Town. REUTERS/Toby Melville A drone view shows Hastings Pier and the seafront at Hastings and St Leonards-on-Sea. REUTERS/Toby Melville People walk past houses in Hastings Old Town. REUTERS/Toby Melville A person views old fishing net huts in The Stade area of Hastings Old Town. REUTERS/Toby Melville Mummified cats, which were discovered inside the pub walls, allegedly from the seventeenth century and preserved to ward off evil spirits, are displayed inside the Stag Inn in Hastings Old Town. REUTERS/Toby Melville Signs are attached to a lamppost in Hastings Old Town. REUTERS/Toby Melville A person buys fish from a fish shop in the Stade fishing harbour area of Hastings Old Town. REUTERS/Toby Melville People relax in the sun outside a pub in Hastings Old Town. REUTERS/Toby Melville A carriage of the funicular railway on East Hill runs in Hastings Old Town. REUTERS/Toby Melville Participants attend the annual May Day bank holiday Jack In The Green parade and festival. REUTERS/Toby Melville Children carry fishing nets as they walk toward the beach in Hastings Old Town. REUTERS/Toby Melville People fish off the harbor wall at sunrise in Hastings Old Town. REUTERS/Toby Melville If arriving by train, alight at St Leonards Warrior Square station and walk down Kings Road, a vibrant street of cafes, second-hand bookshops, vintage furniture stores and artist-run outlets selling bold screenprints and ceramics. It holds a street market on the first Saturday of each month, featuring handicrafts, organic food, and jewellery. Turn left at the end of the road for your first glimpse of the sea.
What to see: One of my favourite spots on the beach is the strip along Warrior Square and Bottle Alley, a split-level promenade. Beachfront cafes such as Goat Ledge , Starsky & Hatch and The Selkie have breathed new life into this area, and it is a popular place to bask in the sun with a coffee or lunch. The brightly painted wooden huts, twinkly lights and bistro tables on the pebbles bring a festival vibe and you’ll often hear live music here.
A short walk further along the seafront brings you to George Street, a charming pedestrian lane of restaurants, pubs and gift shops at the foot of the castle. The West Hill lift is a historic Victorian funicular railway that will transport you up to the Norman castle for £5.50 ($7.40) round-trip. There you’ll find magnificent views across the English Channel towards France, as well as yoga classes and outdoor film screenings.
The West Hill is also home to the Smugglers Adventure , a fun attraction that tells stories of piracy and smuggling in a warren of caves reputedly once used to conceal contraband. In the 1960s, the caves housed a subterranean nightclub.
To return to the Old Town, hop back on the funicular or follow one of the several steep, winding paths. Look out for the twittens — narrow, medieval alleyways between the houses, as you weave through All Saints Street, Tackleway and the High Street.
What to eat: If you fancy seafood, the grilled “catch of the day” fish bap (or sandwich) at Goat Ledge is always delicious. Alternatively, pick up traditional fish and chips and eat them on the beach. Just watch out for diving seagulls going for your chips.
People relax at Goat Ledge beach cafe at St Leonards-on-Sea. REUTERS/Toby Melville People relax at Selkie Seafood Bar at St Leonards-on-Sea. REUTERS/Toby Melville Oyster shells and other sea food are seen on a beachside table at Selkie Seafood Bar at St Leonards-on-Sea. REUTERS/Toby Melville In St Leonards, Half Man! Half Burger! has some of the best burgers — meat and vegetarian — I've ever tasted, and Three Faces has incredible tapas.
Culture fix: Hastings is unusual in having a beach-launched fishing fleet, with the boats hauled back on to the pebbles when not in use. Right beside them is Hastings Contemporary , a wonderful art gallery whose design mirrors that of the historic black Net Shops used for stowing fishing equipment.
A fisherman throws equipment from a boat after returning from a fishing trip in The Stade area of Hastings Old Town. Hastings has one of the largest working beach-launched fishing fleets in Europe. REUTERS/Toby Melville A tractor pulls a fishing boat up the beach in The Stade area of Hastings Old Town. REUTERS/Toby Melville Walk along Rock-a-Nore Road and stop at the excellent (and free) Fishermen's Museum , which highlights the history of the fleet and tragic storms that have struck. Opposite is the 1902 East Hill lift, Britain's steepest funicular, which takes you up to Hastings Country Park — a beautiful expanse of rolling sandstone cliffs, with breathtaking views down to the sea. Look out for the roaming ponies that graze the heathland.
A young person views exhibits at the Fishermen's Museum in Hastings Old Town. REUTERS/Toby Melville For music lovers, Hastings Philharmonic runs excellent classical concerts throughout the year.
Check the tides: Hastings has a pebble beach, but at low tide, vast stretches of sand are exposed, offering ample space for long strolls. I like to time sea swims for high tide and beach walks for low tide. If this falls at sunset, you'll find the beach packed with locals savouring the views. Look out for hagstones, pebbles with natural holes.
A few times a year, when the tide falls below 60 cm (2 feet), you can glimpse the wreck of the Amsterdam, a Dutch East India Company ship that ran aground in 1749 outside St Leonards and was exposed by shifting sands in 1969. It makes for an eerie sight. A replica is moored outside Amsterdam's Maritime Museum , while Hastings' excellent Shipwreck Museum displays the bottles, spoons and other goods found onboard.
The 1066 battlefield: A 15-minute train ride 6 miles (9.5 km) inland brings you to the town of Battle, where King Harold’s Saxon army was defeated by William’s Norman invaders. You can visit the former battlefield and ruined abbey, built by William's son on the spot where Harold perished, and explore a medieval gatehouse. Centuries on, walking the trail around the battlefield where thousands died remains a sombre and moving experience.
A good pint: Hastings has no shortage of charming local boozers. The 16th-century Stag Inn on All Saints Street has a pretty, tiered garden overlooking the rooftops. Look out for the mummified cat that was found encased within the chimney — a practice said to ward off evil in British folklore.
Another good pub is the FILO (First In Last Out) on the High Street, with an unusual indoor fire pit and cosy wooden booths that are always packed on weekends. It brews its own traditional ales and has been joined in recent years by other craft beer makers, including The Brewing Brothers , who run three excellent venues. In the Old Town, the Jenny Lind , named after a 19th-century Swedish opera singer, is one of Hastings' most-loved pubs with regular acoustic nights and folk, rock and sea shanty sessions. Over in St Leonards, The Piper draws a younger crowd and holds regular gigs upstairs.
Get festive: Dig out green clothes and flower crowns for the annual "Jack in the Green" folk festival on the first Monday of May. Dancers and drummers dressed in green parade through the town and up on to the West Hill, where the Jack — a crowned figure clad in foliage — is symbolically slain to release the spirit of summer. It's all rather reminiscent of the 1973 folk horror film "The Wicker Man," and seems to get bigger every year.
A participant attends the annual May Day bank holiday Jack In The Green parade and festival. REUTERS/Toby Melville Participants attend the annual May Day bank holiday Jack In The Green parade and festival. REUTERS/Toby Melville A participant attends the annual May Day bank holiday Jack In The Green parade and festival. REUTERS/Toby Melville In July, locals rustle up striped shirts and eye patches for Pirate Weekend , which brings three days of live music to the shore, and a noisy parade through the town for all “pirates” to join. In October, an annual bonfire marks the anniversary of the Norman Conquest, with a flaming torch procession through the Old Town and a huge blaze and fireworks on the beach.
CITY MEMO DATA POINTS
Population: 91,000
Price of a cup of coffee: £3.80 ($5) for a flat white at Starsky & Hatch
Price of an ice cream: £3.00 ($4) for a Flake 99 — vanilla soft-serve served in a wafer cone with a small chocolate bar on top — from Dom's Ices . For £3.90 ($5.17), you can get a scoop of gelato at Di Pola's .
Great place to see a sunset: The coastal paths of the Country Park, or the West or East Hill

items.title: Record-breaking Renshaw puts Australia on top in Durban
items.author: Mark Gleeson
items.creator: Mark Gleeson
items.summary: Matt Renshaw struck a career-best 190 to guide Australia to 390 all out on day two of the first test against South Africa at Kingsmead on Saturday, as the home side reached 27 for one in reply before play was ended prematurely by bad light.
items.body:
Matt Renshaw struck a career-best 190 to guide Australia to 390 all out on day two of the first test against South Africa at Kingsmead on Saturday, as the home side reached 27 for one in reply before play was ended prematurely by bad light.
Aiden Markram (15 not out) and David Bedingham (12 not out) will resume on the third morning for South Africa, who were frustrated by the record-breaking innings of Renshaw.
Ryan Rickelton was the hosts' wicket to fall when he was caught at third slip by Beau Webster for a duck off the bowling of Josh Hazlewood.
The day belonged to Renshaw as he shared a record ninth-wicket stand of 134 for Australia against South Africa with Nathan Lyon (27), also the highest partnership for that wicket in Durban.
"There was a lot of thinking today while batting," Renshaw said. "How many balls can I face? How do I get off strike when I need to? It was thinking what we can try and do, trying to find the right options, find a boundary if we could.
"Keeping them out in the field, getting their quicks coming back on. I saw (Marco) Jansen bowled 30-odd (overs), (Anrich) Nortje 30-odd, so they've got some overs into the frontline bowlers in the first innings of the first game."
His score is the highest by a number five batter in tests at Kingsmead, but he was out soon after tea when he edged spinner Simon Harmer to Markram at slip.
Australia were in trouble early in Renshaw's innings as they slipped to 124 for six on day one.
EARLY TROUBLE But Renshaw flipped the script after putting on 86 for the seventh wicket with skipper Pat Cummins (43).
Australia started the second day on 187 for six and frustrated the home side before Wiaan Mulder (4-68) had Cummins caught by Markram at second slip.
Mitchell Starc (6) followed quickly after being bowled by Mulder, and at it looked as though South Africa would run through the lower order.
Lyon was circumspect, however, and Renshaw rotated the strike superbly to make sure he had most of the strike and continued to accumulate runs rather than attack the bowling.
Lyon fell LBW to Marco Jansen (3-68).
Renshaw’s 190 has come off 397 balls, a classic test innings of patience and waiting for the bad ball.
He was struck in the helmet by speedster Anrich Nortje, but he soon settled again and his second test century came nine years after his first, 185 against Pakistan in 2017.
Renshaw had made single-figure scores in 11 of his previous 13 test innings.
"He played beautifully throughout the innings, played what was in front of him and left well," Mulder said. "The partnerships built around him and he played the situation as well as anyone could have at this level.
"It is a good cricket wicket and will get a bit up and down as the game goes on and spin more."

items.title: Rosatom and Finland's Fennovoima claim different wins after tribunal ruling
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Russia's state nuclear corporation Rosatom and Finnish utility Fennovoima each highlighted different parts of an International Chamber of Commerce (ICC) tribunal ruling as favourable on Saturday, in a long-running dispute over the cancelled Hanhikivi-1 nuclear power project.
items.body:
Russia's state nuclear corporation Rosatom and Finnish utility Fennovoima each highlighted different parts of an International Chamber of Commerce (ICC) tribunal ruling as favourable on Saturday, in a long-running dispute over the cancelled Hanhikivi-1 nuclear power project.
The parties have been locked in legal disputes since Fennovoima scrapped the 7-billion-euro ($7.8 billion) project in May 2022, citing significant delays and political risks shortly after Russia launched its conflict in Ukraine .
Rosatom said the tribunal found that Fennovoima had unlawfully terminated the contract for the construction of the planned plant in northern Finland.
"Today's victory is important, but not final. We will continue to prove that we are right regarding the Finnish project in courts of various instances," Rosatom Director General Alexey Likhachev said in a statement, which did not refer to any financial outcome.
Fennovoima said the tribunal found that it had not been entitled to terminate the contract, but that it was entitled to receive reimbursements of advance payments and interest in excess of 1 billion euros ($1.12 billion).
It said the tribunal offset both sides' claims, resulting in Rosatom subsidiaries being ordered to pay Fennovoima a net 606 million euros plus interest.
The ICC did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
The contract to build the 1.2 gigawatt plant was signed in 2013 with Fennovoima, a consortium in which Finnish stakeholders including Fortum, Outokumpu and SSAB originally controlled two thirds through a joint venture, and the Russian side held one third.
After the project's termination, Fennovoima wound down its operations and is primarily engaged in legal proceedings.
($1 = 0.8928 euros)

items.title: ゴキブリ党創設者ら拘束、選管トップ抗議封じ込め　インド首都厳戒
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Saurabh Sharma　Aftab Ahmed　Sakshi Dayal

[ニューデリー １０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Saurabh Sharma　Aftab Ahmed　Sakshi Dayal

[ニューデリー １０日 ロイター] - インドの警察は１０日、若者中心の団体「ゴキブリ人民党（ＣＪＰ）」の創設者、アビジート・ディプケ氏を拘束した。首都ニューデリーで予定されていた抗議集会を阻止し、参加者や野党の幹部らも拘束した。警察官や準軍事組織の要員数千人が投入され、首都は厳戒態勢にある。

ニューデリーでは、有権者名簿の見直しに関して不正があったとして選挙管理委員会委員長の辞任を求める抗議集会が予定されていた。当局は、抗議集会が始まる前に一帯を封鎖した。

ディプケ氏は抗議集会に参加するため、ムンバイからデリーに到着した航空機内で警察に拘束された。ＣＪＰは指導者らに対する「権威主義的な拘束」を非難。１０日の集会を率いる指導部を機能不全に陥れるための「事前に計画された足止め」だとして、即時釈放を求めた。

テレビ各局の映像によると、野党議員数人、西ベンガル州首相を務めたママタ・バナジー氏やデリー首都圏首相を務めたアルビンド・ケジリワル氏も拘束された。

デジタルニュースメディア２社の代表者によると、デモを取材していた両社の記者計４人が警察に一時拘束された。ロイターの記者１人も拘束されたが、その後、解放された。

最高裁判所の弁護士会会長は、最高裁前で抗議していた弁護士数人が連行されたが、その後解放されたと述べた。

一連の拘束について、警察からのコメントは得られていない。

治安部隊が主要道路や市内への入り口に検問所を設置しした。主要道路には催涙ガス銃を搭載した暴動鎮圧車両が配備され、警官が車両を検査している。ビジネス街ではインターネット接続が遮断され、数十の地下鉄駅や市場が閉鎖されたが、小規模なデモが行われたもようだ。

items.title: Russian attack on Ukrainian city kills 20, a day after Trump eases diesel sanctions on Moscow
items.author: Sergiy Chalyi, Max Hunder
items.creator: Sergiy Chalyi, Max Hunder
items.summary: The strike on Zaporizhzhia, which killed three children, came a day after President Trump announced a deal to lift sanctions on Russian diesel.
items.body:
Twenty people, including three children, were killed in a Russian attack on the southern Ukrainian city of Zaporizhzhia on Saturday, a day after US President Donald Trump announced a deal to lift sanctions on Russian diesel in a major setback for Kyiv.
"Today, Russia said thank you for the lifting of sanctions on diesel exports by dropping five glide bombs on residential buildings in Zaporizhzhia," Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said, in some of his sharpest criticism yet of the White House.
Zaporizhzhia has been a regular target of Russian bombardment with strikes [USN:L8N43Z01W TEXT:"intensifying in the past few months."]
A 6-year-old girl was among those killed when one strike reduced part of an apartment block to rubble. Her grandfather, Anatoliy Chumniy, stood sobbing over her body, laid on the ground in a white bag, after rescuers pulled it from the wreckage.
"Her birthday would have been at the end of the month," he said through tears.
Eighteen others were wounded in the attack on the industrial city, with a pre-war population of over 700,000 and whose outskirts lie less than 30 km (20 miles) from the front line.
RUSSIA ESCALATING ATTACKS ON UKRAINIAN CITIES It was the third mass-casualty attack on Ukraine this week.
Nearly 80 civilians were killed in Russian strikes on Wednesday and Thursday, including at least 30 killed by a bomb in the eastern garrison city of Kramatorsk and 22 others by a missile in the town of Pryluky, 80 miles east of Kyiv.
A senior official in Zaporizhzhia, Mykhailo Semikin, said Russia had hit several locations simultaneously in the early hours of Saturday.
Rescuers clambered through crumbled masonry to pull other residents of the building out alive. One man, whose leg was trapped in the rubble, screamed in pain as he was being freed.
"If (the Russians) have money, they’ll be able to carry on fighting us," said Nataliia Malysheva, a 49-year-old local resident whose parents died in hospital after being pulled from the rubble.
"How many lives have been lost here, how many homes have been destroyed? How many innocent people have died in the meantime?"
MOSCOW NEEDS 'DIFFERENT SIGNALS' "Last night provided yet more confirmation that Russia perceives any easing of pressure as a signal that it can supposedly keep fighting, that it can supposedly keep dropping bombs on cities. Different signals are needed," Zelenskiy said.
A missile attack on Saturday afternoon also hit a restaurant, wounding seven people in Kyiv.
Russian drones flew over Kyiv throughout the day, part of a vast new wave of bombardment of the capital, the heaviest since the early days of the war.
Russia’s Defence Ministry said on Saturday its drones had struck a data-processing centre in Kyiv and a cargo ship carrying military supplies to the Ukrainian port of Odesa.
TRUMP LIFTS DIESEL SANCTIONS Trump's decision to lift sanctions on Russian diesel exports comes as his administration seeks to curb fuel prices, which have risen sharply during the US conflict with Iran .
Kyiv had instead urged Washington to increase pressure on Moscow in an effort to force it into serious negotiations to end the four-and-a-half-year war .
Trump, meanwhile, has criticised Ukrainian strikes on Russian oil refineries, which he claims have driven up global prices. Kyiv has said it wants a total halt on all energy strikes by both sides as Moscow pummels Ukraine's power grid.
On Saturday, parts of Kyiv and the surrounding region were left without power, bringing the city's metro trains to a complete halt for the second time this week.
The latest strikes came after Ukrainian and European officials held talks with US negotiators in Miami on Friday aimed at developing a common proposal for ending the war, according to [USN:FWN45V1JO TEXT:"a person familiar with the discussions"].
Trump announced the diesel deal while the negotiations were underway, a move Zelenskiy said had caught Kyiv by surprise.
The Ukrainian delegation was headed home on Saturday, presidential aide Dmytro Lytvyn was cited by the Interfax Ukraine news agency as saying.
Russian President Vladimir Putin said after a call with Trump that an immediate resumption of peace talks was unlikely, citing Ukrainian drone attacks on Moscow.
US negotiators Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner may visit Moscow within the next two weeks, Russian state news agency TASS reported on Saturday, citing a source.
Four civilians were killed and five others were wounded as a result of Ukrainian attacks on the [USN:S8N42201C TEXT:"Russian-controlled Luhansk region"] in eastern Ukraine, the Russian-installed governor said on Saturday.
Reuters could not independently verify the report and there was no immediate comment from Ukraine.

items.title: インド、ルピー防衛へドル需要抑制　為替ヘッジ規制を強化
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Jaspreet Kalra　Nimesh Vora

[ムンバイ １０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Jaspreet Kalra　Nimesh Vora

[ムンバイ １０日 ロイター] - インド準備銀行（中央銀行）は１０日、ルピーが過去最安値近辺で推移する中、相場下支えに向け新たな措置を発表した。石油会社のドル調達を直物市場以外に振り向けるとともに、為替ヘッジ規制を強化する。

ルピーは原油価格や世界的な債券利回りの急上昇を背景に下落圧力が続いており、年初来の下落率は７％を超えている。

中銀は国営石油販売会社３社の日々のドル需要を満たす特別窓口を設け、直物市場への圧力を和らげる。

この仕組みでは、中銀が外貨準備から石油会社に直接ドルを供給する。インディアン・オイル、ヒンドゥスタン・ペトロリアム、バーラト・ペトロリアムの３社が１２日から利用可能となる。

ムンバイを拠点とするＡＮＺ銀行の為替ストラテジスト、ディラジ・ニム氏は「石油会社のドル需要に対応することで、為替市場から最大級の需要源の一つが取り除かれ相場変動の抑制につながるだろう。ただ、外貨準備の減少という形で表れることになる」と述べた。

措置の発表後、薄取引の中ルピーはノンデリバラブル・フォワード（ＮＤＦ）市場で対ドルで約０．６％上昇した。

items.title: モンテネグロがロシア軍事ブロガーを国外退去処分　安保上の理由
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ベオグラード ９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ベオグラード ９日 ロイター] - モンテネグロの警察と国家保安機関は９日、ロシアの有力な軍事ブログ「ルイバリ」の創設者が同国で逮捕され、他のロシア人３人とともに国家安全保障上の理由で国外追放処分になったと発表した。

地元紙ポビエダが関係筋の話として報じたところによると、ロシア国防省の元職員でもあるミハイル・ズビンチュク氏が、妻を含む他のメンバーとともにアドリア海沿岸の保養地リサンで「ロシアの影響力」を広めた容疑で拘束された。

ルイバリはロシアのウクライナでの戦争を扱うブログの中でも特に人気が高く、１５０万人を超える登録者を持つ。投稿したメッセージで、ズビンチュク氏らは合法的にモンテネグロに滞在し、同国の修道院で撮影する予定だったと説明した。 

首都ポドゴリツァのロシア大使館は、逮捕の理由について説明を求めたと明らかにした。

ルイバリはロシアの幅広い活動を扱うウェブサイトや情報配信網の一部を構成している。

英国は７月、ルイバリに関係する１０人に制裁を科した。ルイバリはロシア政府から支援を受け、「ウクライナに関する虚偽の言説の拡散や、モルドバ、アルメニアを含む欧州の選挙に干渉してきた責任がある」と非難した。 

ロシア政府は、偽情報の拡散や破壊工作展開の疑いを繰り返し否定し、西側が反ロシアのプロパガンダを広めていると主張している。

モンテネグロとロシアの関係は長年、緊張をはらんできた。２０１６年には、モンテネグロ当局がロシアはセルビアの超国家主義者の集団と共謀してクーデターを企てたと非難。ロシア大統領府はこれを否定した。

モンテネグロが１７年に北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）に加盟すると、関係はさらに悪化した。

モンテネグロのスパイッチ首相は今回の逮捕を巡り、同国を不安定化させる試みや、直接的な軍事衝突に至らない行為を指す「ハイブリッド戦」に直面するとの警告があったと述べた。

items.title: 中国、1─9月の都市部新規雇用1052万人　サービス業支援へ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [北京 １０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[北京 １０日 ロイター] - 中国人力資源・社会保障省は１０日、１─９月の都市部の新規雇用者数が１０５２万人となり、年間目標の８７．７％を達成したと発表した。同省は、サービス業の雇用拡大に向けた新たな措置を計画している。

同省当局者は記者会見で、１─８月の都市部の調査失業率は平均５．２％で、雇用は「おおむね安定」していたと説明した。

李忠次官兼報道官は、他部門と連携しサービス業の発展を通じて雇用を促進する政策文書を策定する方針を示し、サービス業が雇用吸収の主要な受け皿としての機能を一段と発揮できるようにすると述べた。

李氏はまた、労働集約型産業で雇用を安定的に維持するとともに、新興産業や将来有望な産業で新たな雇用機会を模索していくと表明した。

items.title: Jocelyn Bioh on why Broadway is finally ready for 'School Girls'
items.author: Kathryn Lurie
items.creator: Kathryn Lurie
items.summary: The playwright and actor talks beauty, colorism, and how Broadway has changed in the decade since she wrote the play.
items.body:
Playwright Jocelyn Bioh during an interview with Reuters in New York City. REUTERS/Brendan McDermid Nearly a decade after Jocelyn Bioh wrote “School Girls; Or, The African Mean Girls Play,” the play itself has barely changed. But the world around it has.
The comedy about a group of teenage girls at a Ghanaian boarding school premiered off-Broadway in 2017, launching Bioh’s career as a playwright and going on to become a hit at regional theaters across the United States. But despite its success, Bioh was told it might not belong on Broadway.
Now “School Girls” has made it there — following the Broadway success of Bioh’s “Jaja’s African Hair Braiding” in 2023 — and she is finding an audience that responds differently to the play’s exploration of body image, the privileging of lighter skin, known as colorism, and the often brutal social dynamics of girlhood. Beneath its rapid-fire jokes and teenage rivalries is a more painful story about who gets to be considered beautiful — and what people are willing to do to fit that ideal.
Speaking in New York City, Bioh discusses what has changed since “School Girls” was first produced, the universality of teenage insecurity and why bringing the play to Broadway feels like coming full circle.
This conversation has been edited and condensed for clarity.

How does it feel to finally bring “School Girls” to Broadway?
It feels incredibly humbling. This play changed my life. It was the first play of mine that ever got produced. I can very clearly mark what my life was like before opening night of that show and then after.
That audiences and critics all still feel the same way nearly a decade later is a reminder that I was on the right track.
It also feels doubly exciting because even though it had so much success regionally and has been all over the country, I was told, “It's a great play, but maybe it's not the right fit for a Broadway stage.”

What do you think was meant by that, and what has changed enough for it to be on Broadway now?
Broadway shows were very specific then. They didn't have ensembles that looked like the cast of “School Girls.” It was a lot of celebrities, a lot of things that seemed to fit into one specific category or box.
The world has shifted. Audiences are different than they were 10 years ago. In a lot of ways, “Jaja's African Hair Braiding” having so much success was a marker that, a Broadway play is just a play that's on Broadway. It doesn't necessarily have to fit a specific category.

Is there anything in the play that hits differently than it did when you first wrote it?
The conversation around beauty standards and body image has shifted in the last 10 years. Some would say (for the) better, some would say worse, but we're all aware of it in a different way.
The play kicks off with Paulina bullying Nana about her size and her eating. You can feel the audience is immediately on Nana's side. Halfway through the play, she has a moment where she really stands up to Paulina, and every night that moment gets applause. You can feel the audience cheering, almost jumping up ready to fight with her. They're taking off their earrings!
We did not have that experience off-Broadway. I think we were in a time where we accepted the idea that if you were somebody who was bigger, you should be losing weight; you should be trying to conform. Our ideas of beauty are very different now. Big ships turn slow, but I appreciate that I can feel that in the audience.
Did you rewrite much for this production?
Very small things, little jokes that I thought would land better. But the play is still largely the same thing I wrote in 2016.
If I were sitting down to write this play now, I don't know that I would be as honest or as vulnerable as I was then, particularly in the moments where Paulina is speaking very directly about how colorism has affected her life. I think I would censor myself a little bit now. I never thought the play would get produced, so I was very free and vulnerable in a way.

Playwright Jocelyn Bioh. REUTERS/Brendan McDermid Why?
When you're a playwright and your name starts to grow within the community, you start to have an awareness of the responsibility of your words. And I'm okay with having that responsibility because I know I'm doing something really different. I'm really blowing open how people see Black and African people on a theatrical stage. There's an incredible responsibility to that.
The play takes place in Ghana, but these girls feel instantly recognizable. Did you know when you were writing it how universal they would be?
I understood that there's a real rich universality we have, particularly in school and friendship dynamics. Those things are evergreen and universal.
I knew what I was writing was different, (that) the girls and the people I was reflecting were different, but I didn't want to alienate audiences. That's part of why I added the subtitle. What's something we all know and recognize about the teenage experience? Mean girls.
Paulina seems to believe that if she can just become Miss Ghana, she can escape the limits of her life. Is her obsession with beauty really an obsession with power and possibility?
Probably. Ultimately, I think she really believes this is going to set her up for a successful life in entertainment.
The play is set in 1986, and if you became Miss Ghana, Miss World, Miss Universe — any of those things — you could become a star. This is how we have Vanessa Williams or Halle Berry or Kenya Moore, if you're of the “Real Housewives” persuasion.
(Another character,) Eloise, is a former Miss Ghana and did leave. She's come back now living a different life, (signifying that) in order to have success, you've got to get out. In order to have power, you have to get out. Maybe Paulina doesn't see the beauty and power that she can build in her own country.
That's reflective of so many immigrant, particularly African immigrant, stories: In order to have success, you need to leave. I don't know if the play were set in 2026, (if) that would be the case now. I think the play would be very different. But for Paulina and her circumstances then, that is what she believed.
The play deals so directly with colorism. Do you think colorism is in some ways more sensitive to talk about than racism?
They're inextricably linked. The play largely talks about and shows the effects of colorism, but then ends with a global lesson on racism.
And we've not moved on from it. When we started rehearsals for the play in August, the biggest news story was Lupita Nyong'o playing Helen of Troy in Christopher Nolan's film (“The Odyssey”). (Her casting) did not fit with whomever's standard of beauty (for) the woman whose face launched a thousand ships. Why didn't it fit? Why were there so many suggestions about, “Well, Zendaya's in the movie, why can't she play that part?” That's a very clear conversation about colorism, whether people are using that word or not.

When I wrote this play, it was really important for me to have that conversation because it had affected my life so much. Revisiting it now, especially in relation to these conversations that are happening globally, I'm like, well, we've not moved on from it. We can't move on from colorism because nobody's moved on from racism.
I can't change people's minds. But if people come to see “School Girls” and their implicit bias can shift just a little bit, then I've done my job.
The play is extremely funny until you realize how much pain is sitting underneath the humor. How deliberate is that?
I really believe that comedy is just a funny way of being serious. Humor and pain are on two different sides of a truth coin. It's all rooted in truth.
Paulina is a girl in the world who's trying to be affirmed and validated that she belongs there, that her beauty is widely accepted even if she knows that it's not. The lengths she goes to get there are what's comical, but it's rooted in something real that we all experience.
At the end of the day, I'm a comedic writer and I want people to be entertained. But because I know the responsibility of who I'm introducing and the culture I'm introducing, I think there's a responsibility in also educating people. If I can make that medicine go down with a little bit of sugar, honey, agave, whatever you like, I'm willing to go there.
The perspectives expressed in Culture Current are the subject’s own and do not necessarily reflect the views of Reuters News.

items.body:
Yimou Lee　Ben Blanchard

[台北 １０日 ロイター] - 台湾の頼清徳総統は１０日、双十節（建国記念日）の演説で、台湾は平和を大切にするが自由を放棄することはないと述べ、台湾の人々が生存する権利は尊重されなければならないと訴えた。防衛力の強化は挑発ではないとも強調した。

台湾は中国から軍事的・政治的圧力の強化に直面している。中国は一貫して台湾を自国領土と主張しているが、台湾は強く反対している。

台湾は防衛費を増額し軍の近代化を進めているが、 対峙する中国軍の規模ははるかに大きく、ステルス戦闘機や空母、多数のミサイルなどの先進的兵器の配備を進めている。 

頼氏は総統府前で演説し、平和は「願い」だけでは実現できないと強調。 

「台湾は平和を大切にするが、自由を放棄しない。交流には前向きだが、従属は受け入れない」と語った。

また、「権威主義の拡張」に直面する中で、台湾の決意は自らの存続だけに関わるものではないと指摘。

「力がルールに優越することはなく、強者が人々から自らの未来を決める権利を奪うことはできないと、国際社会が今も信じているかどうかの問題だ」と続けた。

防衛投資の拡大については、戦争を挑発するためではなく抑止するためだとして、「対話を放棄するためではなく、対等と尊厳を基礎として対話が行われるようにするために自衛力を強化している」と語った。

頼氏が総統として初めて双十節演説を行った２０２４年の直後、中国は台湾周辺で軍事演習を実施したが、昨年は行わなかった。

台湾周辺で中国が最後に軍事演習を行ったのは昨年１２月下旬で、台湾向けとして過去最大となる１１０億ドル規模の米国の武器売却の報道を受けたものだった。

頼氏は、米国と中国が対話を通じて競争を管理し、紛争や戦争のリスクを低減していることを歓迎すると述べた。

items.title: 米、台湾沖の中国の活動を非難　「著しく安定を損なう」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
[台北 １０日 ロイター] - 米国務省は、台湾東岸沖での中国の海洋活動は「安定を著しく損なう」もので、緊張を悪化させるだけだとの認識を示した。ロイターは先に、８月に同海域で中国の海上民兵船が初めて確認されたと報じていた。

中国は６月以降、沿岸警備隊による定期的な巡視を含め、台湾東岸沖での活動を強化している。

台湾の当局者は、中国が軍、準軍事組織、民間の船舶などを重層的に運用し、海上封鎖の可能性を想定した訓練を行っているとみている。

台湾は、封鎖や有事の際に友好国からの補給ルートとして東岸沖の海域を極めて重要と位置付けている。

米国務省の報道官は、海上民兵の船舶目撃に関する質問に答える形で、米国は台湾東方沖での中国の活動を引き続き懸念していると述べ、「中国の行動は安定を著しく損なうものだ
items.body:
[台北 １０日 ロイター] - 米国務省は、台湾東岸沖での中国の海洋活動は「安定を著しく損なう」もので、緊張を悪化させるだけだとの認識を示した。ロイターは先に、８月に同海域で中国の海上民兵船が初めて確認されたと報じていた。

中国は６月以降、沿岸警備隊による定期的な巡視を含め、台湾東岸沖での活動を強化している。

台湾の当局者は、中国が軍、準軍事組織、民間の船舶などを重層的に運用し、海上封鎖の可能性を想定した訓練を行っているとみている。

台湾は、封鎖や有事の際に友好国からの補給ルートとして東岸沖の海域を極めて重要と位置付けている。

米国務省の報道官は、海上民兵の船舶目撃に関する質問に答える形で、米国は台湾東方沖での中国の活動を引き続き懸念していると述べ、「中国の行動は安定を著しく損なうものだ 」と指摘。 

その上で「台湾が７０年以上にわたり平穏に管理してきた海域に対する権限を主張することで中国は緊張を悪化させ、自ら目指すとしている問題の平和的解決を損なっているだけだ」と述べた。 

また、米国は中国政府に対し、台湾への圧力をやめ「台湾の民主的に選出された当局と意義ある対話」を行うよう求めているとした。

中国外務省はコメント要請に応じていない。

items.title: トランプ氏、平和賞逃し批判　「ノルウェーに消えない汚点」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Jacob Bogage

[シラキュース（米ニューヨーク州） ９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Jacob Bogage

[シラキュース（米ニューヨーク州） ９日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は９日、ノーベル平和賞を受賞できなかったことへの不満を改めて表明し、恥ずべき不名誉な決定でノーベル委員会の本拠地であるノルウェーに汚点を残したと批判した。

委員会は、２０２６年の平和賞を国際刑事裁判所（ＩＣＣ）の元判事ナビ・ピレイ氏に授与すると発表した。同氏は、イスラエルがパレスチナ自治区ガザでジェノサイド（集団虐殺）を行ったと結論付けた国連報告書の取りまとめを主導した。

トランプ氏はニューヨーク州シラキュースでの選挙集会で、ピレイ氏を「正体不明の人物」と呼び「その人物のことは聞いたこともない。誰も知らなかった」と述べた。

トランプ氏は大統領就任以来毎年、平和賞を受賞できなかったことに失望を表明してきた。

トランプ氏は「これはノルウェーという国と、こうした不名誉で恥ずべき決定を下した人々にとって、消すことのできない汚点だ」と述べた。

その上で、自ら解決に関与したと主張する複数の紛争を列挙。根拠は示さなかったが、韓国と北朝鮮、日本と北朝鮮、中国と台湾の間での戦争勃発の回避に貢献したと主張した。

「ノーベル平和賞の信用は、反民主主義的で、まさに文明の敵である一握りの過激な思想の持ち主によって永遠に失われた。ノルウェーよ、われわれは忘れない」と述べた。

items.title: サッカー＝マンＣのマレスカ監督がクラブ擁護、「タイトルの価値に傷なし」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［マンチェスター（英国）　９日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［マンチェスター（英国）　９日　ロイター］ - サッカーのイングランド・プレミアリーグ、マンチェスター・シティー（マンＣ）のエンツォ・マレスカ監督は９日、財務規定違反の問題を抱えている同クラブを擁護した。

マンＣは１１日に行われるプレミアリーグで、先月末に１００件以上の重大な財務規定違反を認定されて以降初の試合となる敵地でのリバプール戦を迎える。クラブはすべての不正行為を否定しており、１日に不服申し立てを行った。

ジョゼップ・グアルディオラ監督の下で３冠を達成した２０２２─２３シーズンにコーチ陣の一員だったマレスカ監督は、リバプール戦に向けた記者会見で、「当時、選手やクラブ、ペップ（グアルディオラ監督）がどれほど努力したか私はよく知っている。だから、その功績を疑う余地など全くない」と語った。また、功績に汚点があると感じるかと問われると、「全くない」と答えた。

６月にグアルディオラ監督の後任として指揮官に就任したマレスカ監督は、契約交渉中に財務規定違反の疑惑に関する話題が上がったことは一度もなかったと明かし、「私はクラブを信頼している。だからこそ、このクラブに加わった。ここ以外に自分がいたいと思うクラブもない。ここにいられることをとても嬉しく思っているし、就任した初日からずっと誇りに感じている」とコメント。就任前に今回の問題の展開を知っていたとしても、「間違いなく」監督職を引き受けていただろうと語った。

items.title: Isaias kills four, about 670,000 without power after landfall
items.author: Rhea Abraham, Rajveer Pardesi, Marianna Parraga
items.creator: Rhea Abraham, Rajveer Pardesi, Marianna Parraga
items.summary: The National Hurricane Center expects storm surges, flash flooding, damaging winds and a risk of tornadoes across parts of the US Southeast.
items.body:
Four people died after Hurricane Isaias made landfall early on Saturday, and about 670,000 residents in Florida, Alabama, Georgia and Mississippi were still without power as the storm weakened to a post-tropical cyclone, according to local authorities and electricity monitoring services.
Two of the deaths resulted from trees falling on homes, according to local media and authorities.
Authorities in Florida had received no search and rescue requests shortly after landfall in a sign of limited impact, Governor Ron DeSantis said. But hazardous conditions remained and storm surges, flash flooding, damaging winds and a risk of tornadoes across parts of the US Southeast were expected, the National Hurricane Center said.
The tornado threat is expected to continue on Saturday across parts of the Florida Panhandle, Georgia and the Carolinas, the NHC said.
In Florida, power restoration was marked as a priority, authorities said, while highways, bridges and airports were reopening, and teams were assessing the damage.
"They're going to make assessments this morning, and I think that'll give us a good sense about the future for the rapidity of the power restoration," DeSantis told a press conference in Tallahassee. Some 16,000 utility linemen had prepared to respond to the storm, he said.
About 420,000 customers in Florida, 190,000 in Alabama, 43,000 in Georgia and 17,000 in Mississippi had no power as of midday Saturday, according to tracking firm PowerOutage.us.
A separate storm on the Pacific Ocean, Rachel, was moving toward the coast of northern Baja California on Saturday, bringing wind gusts and increased tides, which left another 7,000 people without power in California.
Alabama's emergency management agency said the downed trees and power lines made travel hazardous in Houston County, which is under a flash flood warning.
"Due to the impacts of Hurricane Isaias, all Houston County roads are closed until further notice," it posted on X.
A category 2 hurricane when it hit Florida's coast and the first of the 2026 Atlantic season, Isaias is expected to produce gusty winds well inland before weakening below gale force later on Saturday, the NHC said.
On Saturday, oil and gas producer Shell (SHEL.L) said it was beginning to redeploy personnel to its Mars, Olympus, Ursa, Vito and Appomattox assets in the Gulf, while Chevron (CVX.N) was advancing efforts to redeploy staff to its platforms and seeking to restore full production. "Remobilization of crews will continue through Sunday," it said.
Despite the progress, about 69% of oil output and 57% of natural gas production in the US Gulf of Mexico remained shut on Saturday, slightly down from Friday numbers, the Marine Minerals Administration said.
Some 113 production platforms representing 30% of the total remained evacuated, according to the agency.
President Donald Trump, asked about hurricane preparations on Friday, told reporters outside the White House that it was "under control." The US Energy Department said on Saturday it authorized an emergency exchange of up to 4 million barrels of crude oil from the Strategic Petroleum Reserve to address supply disruptions due to the hurricane.
Emergency declarations were approved in Florida and Alabama to ensure federal resources would be available to respond to Isaias, Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin said on X.
"There's also a lot of hazards post-storm that people should be careful of, but so far, we've had a lot of assets in place that have not been called on," DeSantis told FOX News early on Saturday.
In the coastal city of Pensacola, a lack of drinking water is a problem, the mayor said. Pensacola airport, Florida's 10th largest, was damaged by the storm and is closed to commercial flights until further notice.

items.title: サッカー＝監視対象の選手・関係者の過半数が誹謗中傷受信、ＦＩＦＡ発表
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［９日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［９日　ロイター］ - 国際サッカー連盟（ＦＩＦＡ）は９日、２０２６年ワールドカップ（Ｗ杯）北中米３カ国大会においてソーシャルメディア保護サービス（ＳＭＰＳ）によって監視された選手、監督、関係者の計１６０６人のうち、半数以上がオンライン上で誹謗中傷を受けていたと発表した。

監視対象となった１６０６人のうち８１２人が、誹謗中傷と分類されるメッセージを少なくとも１件受信した。差別的な誹謗中傷の中で最も多かったのは人種差別に関するもので、誹謗中傷全体の１２％を占めた。一般的な誹謗中傷を除くと、その割合は２０％に上った。

最も標的とされた特定の個人は１万件以上の誹謗中傷投稿を受け取り、そのうち４０％が人種差別的な内容だった。

ＳＭＰＳは１７１０万件の投稿やコメントを分析し、そのうち約２４万件が人の目による精査を経て誹謗中傷であると確認された。２９０５のアカウントについて調査が必要と判断され、７８６アカウントが審査のため法執行機関に報告された。

投稿監視ツールは、ＦＩＦＡおよび加盟協会の公式チャンネルにおける６０７０万件のコメントをスキャンし、スパムを含め９２０万件を非表示にした。

items.title: ＭＬＢ＝ドジャース山本、リーグ優勝決定Ｓ第2戦で先発へ　初戦はスクバル
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［９日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［９日　ロイター］ - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）ドジャースのデーブ・ロバーツ監督は９日、ブルワーズとのナ・リーグ優勝決定シリーズ（７回戦制）で、１１日の第１戦にタリク・スクバル投手、１２日の第２戦に山本由伸投手を先発させると明らかにした。ＭＬＢ公式サイトが伝えた。

ドジャースはブレーブスとの地区シリーズを３勝１敗で突破。先発したスクバル、ブレーク・スネル、山本、タイラー・グラスノーの４投手は計２１回１／３を投げて自責４、防御率１．６９を記録した。今季のプレーオフ出場チームではレイズの先発陣に次ぐ２番目の好成績となっている。

地区シリーズで第３戦に先発した山本は７回を４安打１失点、１四球、１０三振と好投。中５日で第２戦に登板する予定で、シリーズが第６戦までもつれた場合も通常の登板間隔で先発できる見込み。

山本は昨年のワールドシリーズで最優秀選手（ＭＶＰ）に選出され、最終第７戦では前日の登板から休養なしで救援登板した。今季のプレーオフでも短い登板間隔や救援での起用に応じる意向を示しているが、球団は可能な限り通常の登板間隔を維持する方針。

スネルがリーグ優勝決定シリーズ第３戦、グラスノーが第４戦に先発する可能性がある。ドジャースは昨年まで２年連続でワールドシリーズを制しており、３連覇を目指す。

items.title: Ｆ１＝シンガポールＧＰスプリント予選、フェルスタッペンがトップ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［シンガポール　９日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［シンガポール　９日　ロイター］ - 自動車レースＦ１の第１７戦、シンガポール・グランプリ（ＧＰ）は９日、スプリント予選を行い、レッドブルのマックス・フェルスタッペン（オランダ）がトップタイムを記録した。

フェルスタッペンは１分３１秒１５６をマークし、２番手のジョージ・ラッセル（英国、メルセデス）に０秒１２０差をつけた。シンガポールでは過去に、ポールポジション（ＰＰ）獲得も優勝もともに経験していなかった。

フェルスタッペンは「ソフトタイヤを装着すると、マシンが少し生き返ったように感じた。トップになれるとは予想していなかったので、とてもうれしい」とコメントした。

３番手はシャルル・ルクレール（モナコ、フェラーリ）。総合首位のキミ・アントネッリ（イタリア、メルセデス）は７番手だった。

ラッセルは同日のフリー走行でトップタイムを記録したが、パワーユニットの部品交換に伴い、１１日の決勝では計４０グリッド降格のペナルティーを受ける。ただ、１０日のスプリントには影響しない。

スプリント予選の最初のセッションでは、セルヒオ・ペレス（メキシコ、キャデラック）が防護壁に衝突し、コース上に破片が散乱したため赤旗中断となった。その後、計時システムの不具合で第２セッションの開始が遅れたほか、追い抜き支援機能の作動にも問題が発生した。

items.title: India detains thousands, locks down Delhi to foil election chief protest
items.author: Saurabh Sharma, Sarita Singh, Sakshi Dayal
items.creator: Saurabh Sharma, Sarita Singh, Sakshi Dayal
items.summary: Thousands of police and paramilitary personnel deployed across the city, mobile internet services were suspended and dozens of metro stations and markets were shut as authorities moved to stop a rally organized by the Cockroach movement.
items.body:
Police detained more than 2,000 protesters and the founder of the "Cockroach" youth movement in Delhi on Saturday as security forces [USN:L1N45V075 TEXT:"locked down"] parts of the capital to thwart a rally demanding the resignation of India's election chief.
Thousands of police and paramilitary personnel were deployed across the city, mobile internet services were suspended in the central business district and dozens of metro stations and markets were shut as authorities moved to stop a demonstration organised by the Cockroach movement.
The protest was aimed at Chief Election Commissioner [USN:L4N45K0DB TEXT:"Gyanesh Kumar"] over a [USN:L1N45V037 TEXT:"revision of voter lists"] that critics say disproportionately benefits Prime Minister Narendra Modi's ruling Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).
The movement had planned to gather thousands of people at Jantar Mantar in central Delhi, but the area was sealed off by security forces before the demonstration began.
A home ministry official, speaking on condition of anonymity, told Reuters more than 2,000 people were detained in Delhi. Local media said about 400 protesters were held in India's financial hub, Mumbai.
There was no immediate comment from police on the detentions.
The United Nations human rights office expressed concerns over mass detentions before and during the protests.
"We call on the authorities to ensure that the right to peaceful assembly is fully respected and fulfilled," UN Human Rights Spokesperson Thameen Al-Kheetan said in a statement.
He also urged authorities to engage in "meaningful dialogue" to address the "broadly held" concerns expressed.
The Indian mission to the UN in Geneva, however, called the UN's concerns "misplaced" and said they constitute "an unwarranted interference in the internal affairs of India."
It stressed that the right to peaceful assembly was guaranteed by India's Constitution. "As in every democracy, Indian citizens exercise this right subject to reasonable restrictions in the interest of public order," the statement added.
MOVEMENT LEADERS HELD Police detained Cockroach Janta Party founder Abhijeet Dipke and senior leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka when their flight from Mumbai landed in Delhi, the group said in a statement.
Television footage showed Dipke challenging officers who approached him on board the aircraft.
"I have come to be arrested, arrest me ... I am not afraid of you guys," he said.
"No, this is not an arrest," one officer replied. "Please cooperate."
The movement condemned what it called the "authoritarian detention" of its leaders, demanded their release and vowed to continue protesting.
"We will continue our protest tomorrow, day after ... until Gyanesh Kumar resigns. We will be on the streets," CJP leader Ajinkya Shinde told reporters.
CJP also said authorities refused to provide updates on the leaders' whereabouts or health, even after news arrived of the death of Dipke's grandmother. Police said Dipke was informed of her death and was offered help to return home for the funeral.
Some opposition lawmakers and former chief ministers Mamata Banerjee of West Bengal, Arvind Kejriwal of Delhi, and Pinarayi Vijayan of Kerala were also detained, TV channels showed.
Representatives of two digital news outlets said police briefly detained four of their reporters while they were covering the demonstrations. A Reuters journalist was also detained briefly before being released.
Across the capital of about 20 million people, security forces set up checkpoints on major roads and entry points, boarded buses searching for protesters and inspected vehicles. Barricades and concrete blocks disrupted traffic while anti-riot vehicles equipped with tear-gas launchers guarded key routes.
NEW CHALLENGE TO MODI The demonstrations represent one of the most serious tests yet for Modi, stemming from allegations that election authorities improperly revised voter rolls ahead of recent state polls.
Protests intensified after the Indian Express reported last week that two election commissioners had questioned Kumar's voter-list revisions that removed roughly 130 million names from voter lists.
Kumar has not commented but the Election Commission and the BJP have denied allegations of wrongdoing.
The BJP says its electoral success reflects Modi's popularity and India's economic growth, and accuses opposition parties of spreading misinformation.
The near [USN:L6N45U0IF TEXT:"daily protests"] come just months after demonstrations over exam paper leaks forced his [USN:L1N43R02E TEXT:"education minister to quit"].
The unrest also comes ahead of a series of important state elections beginning in early 2027.
Rahul Gandhi, leader of the main opposition Congress party, said Modi's opponents would not back down.
A senior BJP member, Ravi Shankar Prasad, said the party was not opposed to demonstrations but the street protests had been "weaponised" by rivals due to election defeats.
DELETIONS AFFECTED STATE POLLS, OPPOSITION ALLEGES Opposition parties say the deletions affected the outcome of recent state elections won by the BJP and have cast a shadow over voting in the world's largest democracy.
Election Commission data show about 130 million voter entries were removed during the verification exercise, including 63 million people who had relocated, 30 million who could not be traced and 28 million who had died.
The commission says the removals relate to entries identified during the draft revision process and that any eligible voter incorrectly deleted can re-enrol.

items.title: ＮＢＡ＝レブロン、シクサーズでのプレシーズン初戦で10得点
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［９日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［９日　ロイター］ - 米プロバスケットボール協会（ＮＢＡ）のセブンティシクサーズに加入したレブロン・ジェームズ（４１）は８日、ネッツとのプレシーズン戦で移籍後初出場を果たし、１０得点５アシストを記録した。

レブロンはフィールドゴールの試投がわずか１本だったものの、フリースロー８本を全て成功させた。プレーしたのは前半のみで後半は出場せず、シクサーズは１０８─１１４で敗れた。

レブロンは試合後、「新しいユニホームを着ていたのは確かだが、バスケットボールはバスケットボール。コート上でプレーするものだ」と語り、これまで練習でともに汗を流してきたチームメートと実戦に臨めたことを喜んだ。

レブロンは７月、フリーエージェント（ＦＡ）として２年総額８００万ドル（約１２億７０００万円）、選手オプション付きの契約で加入。昨季はレーカーズで６０試合に出場し、１試合平均２０．９得点６．１リバウンド７．２アシストを記録した。

オールスター選出２２回を誇るレブロンは、通算出場試合数（１６２２）と通算得点（４万３４４０）でＮＢＡ歴代最多記録を保持。ヒートで２回、キャバリアーズとレーカーズで各１回、ＮＢＡ制覇を果たしている。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［９日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［９日　ロイター］ - 米男子ゴルフの秋季シリーズ、ベイカレント・クラシック・レクサスは９日、神奈川県横浜ＣＣ（パー７１）で第２ラウンドを行い、米沢蓮が日本勢最高の２０位につけた。

前日１７位の米沢は４バーディー、２ボギーの６９で回り、通算５アンダーの１３７。１２位スタートの松山英樹は３バーディー、４ボギーの７２とスコアを落とし、通算３アンダーの３０位に後退した。

同じく１２位で出た久常涼は７１で回り、通算４アンダーの１３８で２６位。金谷拓実と砂川公佑は３０位、岩田寛と石坂友宏は３８位、藤本佳則と細野勇策は４６位、香妻陣一朗は５４位、中島啓太は６１位、岩崎亜久竜は６３位、アマチュアの長崎煌心は７０位だった。

首位には通算１１アンダーでキース・ミッチェルとジェーコブ・ブリッジマン（ともに米国）が並んだ。ミッチェルは８バーディー、２ボギーの６５で６つ伸ばし、ブリッジマンは４バーディー、１ボギーの６８で回った。

CARACAS, Oct 9 : Venezuela's interim President Delcy Rodriguez has authorized Starlink, the satellite internet service operated by Elon Musk's SpaceX, to operate in the Latin American country.
The authorization is part of an agreement with the US firm, the Venezuelan government said in a statement on Friday.
The company's satellite-internet unit has continued to expand its global subscriber base, aided by launches of additional satellites and a growing range of consumer, enterprise, aviation, maritime and government services.

items.author: ロイター

items.summary: ［ランス（フランス）　９日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ランス（フランス）　９日　ロイター］ - サッカーのフランス１部は９日、１試合を行い、２位リヨンは敵地でＲＣランスに１─２で敗れ、今季初黒星を喫した。リヨンの中村敬斗は後半１５分から途中出場した。

リヨンは前後半に１点ずつ奪われて２点のビハインドを背負ったが、後半３９分に相手が退場者を出して数的優位に立つと、直後に１９歳カリス・メラが相手守備陣のミスを突いて１点を返した。しかし、反撃もそこまでで、開幕からの無敗が途絶えた。

リヨンは勝ち点１１で暫定２位。一方、ＲＣランスは同７とし、１５位から暫定７位に浮上した。

items.title: テニス＝マスターズ上海大会、坂本が3回戦進出　ジョコビッチは敗退
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［上海　９日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［上海　９日　ロイター］ - テニスのマスターズ上海大会は９日、男子シングルス２回戦を行い、予選勝者の坂本怜が第２３シードでロシア出身のアンドレイ・ルブレフを６─４、６─４のストレートで破り、３回戦進出を果たした。

世界ランキング１３７位の坂本は第１セットの第１ゲームでブレークに成功。第２セットも第９ゲームで相手のサービスゲームを破り、元世界５位の格上選手から金星を挙げた。３回戦では第９シードのアレックス・デミノー（オーストラリア）と対戦する。

過去４回優勝の第１０シード、ノバク・ジョコビッチ（セルビア）はフベルト・フルカチュ（ポーランド）に４─６、３─６で敗れ、初戦で姿を消した。

ジョコビッチはこれまでフルカチュとの対戦で８戦全勝だった。試合後、「北京でプレーしていた時の状態には程遠かった。少し疲れていて、フレッシュではなかった」と振り返った。

第１シードのアレクサンダー・ズベレフ（ドイツ）、第３シードのベン・シェルトン（米国）は順当に勝利した。

SAN FRANCISCO, Oct 9 : Six-month-old microchip startup Nuvacore, which does not yet have a product, is raising hundreds of millions of dollars at a roughly $2.5 billion valuation to develop a new central processor designed for data centers, according to two people familiar with the fundraising.
Nuvacore is seeking to raise the funds as the appetite for central processors has swollen due to the thirst for data-crunching capacity to power chatbots such as Anthropic's Claude. CPUs perform vital functions as traffic controllers for Nvidia's AI chips and run autonomous AI software known as agents. 
The roughly $2.5 billion valuation has not been previously reported. The Information reported previously that Nuvacore was raising $200 million or more. The funding round has not closed, and the people cautioned that the valuation and size of the capital raise could change.
Intel and Advanced Micro Devices, which use x86 technology, have long dominated the data center CPU market. Companies designing chips based on Arm's technology — found inside Amazon and Microsoft custom CPUs — have also attempted to make inroads in the data center market.

Nuvacore has not yet developed a product. Last month, it described an unconventional design strategy: to build the core functionality of the chip before committing to an architecture such as the x86 used by Intel and AMD, or Arm, which is used in most mobile phones. 
The design strategy will allow the company's engineers to avoid the limitations and requirements of specific architectures and optimize a design for the type of computations that are most common in data centers and AI infrastructure, Nuvacore said.
Nuvacore declined to comment.
The San Jose, California-based startup was founded by renowned engineers Gerard Williams, John Bruno and Ram Srinivasan. Williams, a former Apple executive, sold a prior startup called Nuvia to Qualcomm for $1.4 billion in 2021.
Nuvacore earlier this year announced a seed funding round led by Sequoia Capital. It joins a series of young chip startups that have sought billion-dollar valuations before releasing a product as investor appetite for AI hardware companies has returned.
Over the past decade, Silicon Valley venture capital firms have taken much less interest in hardware than software because of hardware's longer development cycles, higher capital needs and the industry's cyclical demand.
Investors put about $10.7 billion into semiconductor startups in the first five months of 2026, already outpacing the $12.2 billion raised globally in all of 2025, according to Crunchbase data.
Earlier this year, Intel said it could not manufacture enough chips to meet demand, and was able to sell products it had previously determined were too faulty for sale. AMD also described swelling CPU sales in a recent results conference call with analysts.
Shares in both companies have risen more than 180 per cent this year.
Nvidia launched a CPU called Vera this year. CEO Jensen Huang has said the company expects to sell $20 billion worth of its Vera CPU in this fiscal year, which ends in January.

items.title: Super Micro contractor pleads guilty in scheme to divert AI servers with Nvidia chips to China
items.author: Karen Freifeld, Jaspreet Singh
items.creator: Karen Freifeld, Jaspreet Singh
items.summary: Ting-Wei "Willy" Sun pleaded guilty to four counts.
items.body:
A contractor linked to Super Micro Computer (SMCI.O) has pleaded guilty in a scheme to illegally export computer servers containing advanced Nvidia (NVDA.O) AI chips to China, a federal court filing showed on Friday.
Ting-Wei "Willy" Sun pleaded guilty to four counts, including conspiracies to violate US export controls, smuggle goods from the US, defraud the country and obstruct justice. He entered the plea on Thursday in U.S. District Court in Manhattan.
The United States and China are competing for dominance in AI, with both investing billions of dollars in a technology seen as critical to economic growth, national security and military capabilities.
In March, [USN:L1N4071M5 TEXT:"prosecutors charged"] Sun and two others associated with Super Micro, including a co-founder of the AI-server maker, with conspiring to divert about $2.5 billion worth of US AI technology to China in violation of export laws.
The scheme began around October 2023, with Sun and others conspiring to export servers from a US manufacturer, widely believed to be Super Micro, to China without the required licenses, according to the indictment.
Asked for comment on the guilty plea, California-based Super Micro referred to its prior statements that the company was not named as a defendant in the indictment and that it had no impact on its business operations. [USN:L4N40Q1GS TEXT:"Super Micro"] terminated Sun and cut ties with the other defendants earlier this year.
A lawyer for Sun declined to comment.
Also indicted were the co-founder Yih-Shyan "Wally" Liaw and Ruei-Tsang "Steven" Chang, who was a sales manager at Super Micro's Taiwan office, while Sun was a contractor.
A lawyer for Liaw - who co-founded Super Micro in 1993 and joined its board in 2023 - did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Chang's lawyer could not immediately be reached for comment.
The indictment described Sun as a broker and “fixer” who facilitated orders and took steps to conceal the scheme. He helped stage "dummy" servers in December 2025 and made false statements to a US Department of Commerce officer during an inspection of supposedly stored servers, which had already been diverted to China, according to the indictment.
Washington has restricted sales of advanced AI chips to China, citing national security concerns. The indictment said Nvidia's B200, H100 and H200 graphics processing units, and servers containing them, were subject to the restrictions.

items.title: 米欧・ウクライナが和平案協議　米ロ軽油合意と同日
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ワシントン　９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ワシントン　９日 ロイター] - 米国、ウクライナ、欧州の交渉担当者が９日、マイアミでウクライナ戦争終結に向けた統一提案での合意を目指し、６時間にわたる協議を行った。協議に詳しい関係者が明らかにした。

匿名を条件に語った同関係者によると、今後数週間で案をまとめてロシアに提示し、冬を迎える前に事態の打開を図ることを目指している。

同日、トランプ米大統領は、燃料価格の引き下げに向けてロシアが世界市場にディーゼル（軽油）を供給することで合意したと発表。米政権は、ロシアの戦費となる収入を断つために課していたロシア産燃料への制裁を解除した。この合意は米議員やウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領から批判を浴びた。 

ゼレンスキー氏は声明で「資金は全て、人々に対する、ウクライナに対する、そしてわれわれ全員に対する戦争に使われる。わが交渉チームは単に目くらましに使われているに過ぎないと考えている。それは決して公正ではない」と述べた。

ロシアのプーチン大統領はトランプ氏との電話会談後、ウクライナによるモスクワへのドローン攻撃を理由に、和平協議を直ちに再開する可能性は低いとの見方を示した。

マイアミでの協議には米国のウィットコフ、クシュナー両特使とウクライナ代表団のほか、欧州と北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）の代表者が出席した。

関係者によると、交渉担当者は幅広い議題について話し合った。その中には、米国と欧州による安全保障の確約を含むウクライナ向けの戦後パッケージも含まれた。

また、ウクライナ向けの戦後経済計画や、欧州連合（ＥＵ）加盟に向けた道筋についても協議された。

ただ関係者は、センシティブな問題として、領土を巡る「幾つかのアイデア」も議論されたとしたが、詳細には立ち入らなかった。

今後の平和な時代の土台となる、欧州とロシアの安全保障体制についても議論された。関係者は詳細には触れなかった。

SAN FRANCISCO, Oct 9 : Amazon on Friday confirmed it was shuffling leadership in its Alexa division, a day after the company announced its first tablet computers featuring the voice assistant.
Daniel Rausch, a 17-year Amazon veteran who has served as vice president of Alexa and Echo for over three years, is stepping away from the unit next month, Amazon said in response to a Reuters inquiry.
Rausch, who has served as the face of Alexa at events and global launches, will return in another capacity in the devices and services division in 2027.
In his place, Amazon will install Aidan Marcuss, currently the vice president of Fire TV, advertising and the Amazon appstore. Marcuss joined Amazon from Microsoft in early 2025. He oversaw the release of a new Fire TV stick last month, which has garnered mixed reviews.

Amazon spent several years developing a new version of the voice assistant offering generative AI that can respond to longer prompts. The service is featured in the new Alexa Tablets announced on Thursday that Amazon has priced as a high-end product compared with prior Fire tablets that were inexpensive.

Yasmine Ghania　Enas Alashray　Federico Maccioni

[ドバイ／カイロ ９日 ロイター] - イスラエルのテルアビブに向かっていたアラブ首長国連邦
items.body:
Yasmine Ghania　Enas Alashray　Federico Maccioni

[ドバイ／カイロ ９日 ロイター] - イスラエルのテルアビブに向かっていたアラブ首長国連邦 （ＵＡＥ）の格安航空フライドバイ機内で副操縦士が機長を襲撃した事件について、ＵＡＥ検察当局は９日、副操縦士は２００１年９月１１日に起きた米同時多発攻撃に触発され、この旅客機を乗っ取った上でテルアビブのベングリオン空港のターミナルに墜落させる自爆攻撃を計画していたと明らかにした。

ＵＡＥ検察当局は９月３０日の事件発生を受け、１０月１日に捜査に着手。ＵＡＥのアルシャムシ司法長官が発表した声明に、フライドバイによる不正行為を示唆する内容はなかった。副操縦士が米同時多発攻撃に影響を受けていたと公に確認されるのは今回が初めてとなる。

捜査当局はフライドバイの採用手続きを調査した結果、事件を起こした副操縦士は操縦士免許の保有や無犯罪証明書の提出など、全ての職業上および保安上の要件を満たしていたと確認。アルシャムシ司法長官は「いずれの手続きでも、副操縦士の過激思想や攻撃計画を実行する意図を示す兆候は見つからなかった」とした。

副操縦士は２９歳でオマーン国籍。アルシャムシ司法長官によると、２６年１月にフライドバイに入社する前、オマーン航空を含む複数の航空会社で勤務していた。捜査では、副操縦士がオーストラリアに留学していた１７年時点から、「過激主義とテロリズム」に傾倒し始めた兆候が確認されたとしている。また、副操縦士は「テロ」を扇動する資料を閲覧したり、ボクシングの訓練を受けたりして、攻撃に向けた精神的、身体的準備を進めていたと捜査当局に供述したことも明らかにした。

items.title: US lifts sanctions on daughter of Myanmar military-linked businessman
items.author: Simon Lewis
items.creator: Simon Lewis
items.summary: The United States lifted on Friday sanctions on the daughter of a Myanmar businessman accused of supporting the country's military, according to the US Treasury Department's website, after she filed a suit seeking removal from the blacklist.
items.body:
The United States lifted on Friday sanctions on the daughter of a Myanmar businessman accused of supporting the country's military, according to the US Treasury Department's website, after she filed a suit seeking removal from the blacklist.
The move comes after Reuters reported this week that the Trump administration had [USN:L6N45T16N TEXT:"opened talks with Myanmar's military-installed government"], reversing US policy that sought to isolate the generals who overthrew elected leaders in 2021.
A State Department spokesperson said the decision to remove Myanmar national Theint Win Htet from the Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List (SDN List) "reflects the administration’s determination that this designation no longer effectively supports US policy objectives related to Burma."
"The administration is using a range of tools to advance key priorities regarding Burma, such as combating scam centers, improving Burma's domestic operating environment for US businesses, and encouraging a peace process to address the ongoing violence and humanitarian crisis," the spokesperson said, using the country's previous name.
After the 2021 coup, former President Joe Biden's administration imposed sanctions on senior Myanmar military officers and companies it accused of providing support for the military junta, which triggered a nationwide civil war that has killed an estimated 100,000 people and displaced more than 3.5 million.
The Treasury in January 2024 [USN:S0N3D107F TEXT:"targeted the "][USN:S0N3D107F TEXT:"Shwe Byain Phyu Group of Companies"], its founder Thein Win Zaw and his family, saying the company imported and distributed petroleum on behalf of the military and that the family owned at least 20 companies closely associated with the regime.
Thein Win Zaw's adult daughter, Theint Win Htet, sued the Biden administration seeking her removal from the SDN List, but her case was dismissed in February 2025. The sanctions freeze any US assets of those targeted and generally bar Americans from dealing with them.
The US in July 2025 [USN:L1N3TM01T TEXT:"lifted sanctions"] on several other Myanmar nationals and a firm under sanctions for aiding the military.
Theint Win Htet filed a new complaint in July this year, arguing that she has no active role in her father's business affairs, adding that the sanctions had interrupted her studies in the US, where she completed a bachelor's degree at New York University and was enrolled in a master's program at Columbia University.
"Plaintiff’s US credit cards have been blocked, her foreign bank accounts have been restricted, closed, or refused, and she has been unable to complete her university studies in the United States," said the complaint by Theint Win Htet, who said in the complaint she now lives with her mother in Bangkok. Her mother was removed from the sanctions list last year.
Campaign group Justice For Myanmar denounced the US move at a time when it said the Myanmar military was escalating attacks on civilians. "It is deplorable that the US government continues to delist Myanmar cronies and their family members that provide funding for the junta's terror," the group said.
Theint Win Htet's lawyer, Washington-based sanctions specialist Erich Ferrari, filed a notice with the US District Court for the District of Columbia on Friday voluntarily dismissing the lawsuit after her delisting. Ferrari declined to comment.
items.raw_description: The United States lifted on Friday sanctions on the daughter of a Myanmar businessman accused of supporting the country's military, according to the US Treasury Department's website, after she filed a suit seeking removal from the blacklist.

items.body:
＜為替＞　ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対しやや上昇した。市場で様子見姿勢が強まる中、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の金融政策の行方を見極めようと、ＦＲＢ当局者の発言が注目されている。    終盤の取引でドルは対円で０．２５％高の１５８．２５円。週間ベースで円は対ドルで４週連続で下落した。    ユーロ／ドルは０．１％安の１．１１９８ドル。週間ベースでは約０．５％下落した。週間ベースでは５週連続の下落で、２０２５年初旬以降で最長となった。ユーロはフランスの公的債務などに対する懸念などが重荷になり、５日の取引で１．１１６１ドルと１年５カ月ぶりの安値を更新していた。    世界の債券市場はこれまで売りが優勢だったが、トランプ米大統領が中間選挙前にイランを攻撃しないと表明し原油価格が下落したことなどで、この日は落ち着きを取り戻した。    ＣＭＥフェドウオッチによると、２７─２８日の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で少なくとも０．２５％ポイントの利上げが決定される確率は１９．４％。ただ、その次の１２月８─９日のＦＯＭＣで利上げが決定される確率は８５．８％と、年内に追加利上げが実施されるとの観測は依然として強い。    来週はウォーシュＦＲＢ議長が１６日にタイのバンコクで開かれる国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）年次総会で講演を行う。    主要通貨に対するドル指数は０．１３％高の１０２．２５。週間ベースでは約０．３％上昇。上昇は４週連続で、２５年５月以来の長さとなる。 

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞　国債利回りが上昇し、今週前半の低下分の一部を打ち消した。投資家は来週発表されるインフレ指標に注目。連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が１０月２７─２８日の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で下す金利決定の手掛かりを見極めようとしている。     指標となる１０年債利回りは２．８ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）上昇の５．２６１％。ただ週間では３．５ｂｐ低下し、低下幅は過去２カ月で最大となった。     ２年債利回りは４．４ｂｐ上昇の４．７９９％。    ３０年債利回りは５．６０８％と小幅に上昇。週間では２．９ｂｐ低下した。      ２年債と１０年債の利回り格差は４５．５ｂｐと、８日終盤の４６．７ｂｐから縮小した。     市場は、来週発表されるインフレ指標に注目。消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）は１４日、卸売物価指数（ＰＰＩ）は１５日にそれぞれ発表される。    金利先物市場が織り込む、ＦＲＢが今月のＦＯＭＣで金利を据え置く確率は８０％。 

米金融・債券市場：[US/BJ]

＜株式＞　主要３指数が揃って上昇して取引を終えた。投資家の関心は、本格化する第３・四半期決算発表や、インフレ指標の発表が予定される来週に移っている。    主要３指数は週間でもプラスとなった。ただ、小型株で構成するラッセル2000指数は前週末終値を下回って引けた。    第３・四半期の決算発表シーズンは来週本格化する。米大手銀のウェルズ・ファーゴ、ゴールドマン・サックス、シティグループ、ＪＰモルガン・チェース、バンク・オブ・アメリカ、モルガン・スタンレーが決算を発表する予定だ。    ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、アナリストはＳ＆Ｐ５００構成企業の７─９月期利益が前年比３０．６％増加すると予想。セクター別ではエネルギーが１２３％、テクノロジーが６６．５％と、前年比で最大の増益率が見込まれている。    この日は、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００の主要１１セクターのうち、下落したのはコミュニケーション・サービスのみだった。    人工知能（ＡＩ）関連銘柄は総じて上昇。ラウンドヒル・マグニフィセント・セブンＥＴＦは１％上昇した。    米実業家イーロン・マスク氏率いるスペースＸは８日、全米をカバーする低周波数帯の利用権を取得する契約を結んだ。nL6N45V01U    これを受けて通信大手ＴモバイルＵＳ、ＡＴ＆Ｔ、ベライゾンは８．８─１３．３％下落した。    アップルは１．１％下落した。メモリーチップのコスト高騰と値上げが消費者需要を冷やす中、同社が一部サプライヤーに対し、新発売した「ｉＰｈｏｎｅ１８　Ｐｒｏ」と「ｉＰｈｏｎｅ１８　Ｐｒｏ　Ｍａｘ」向け部品の生産を削減するよう指示したと報じられた。    ニューヨーク証券取引所（ＮＹＳＥ）では値上がり銘柄数が値下がり銘柄数を１．６５対１の比率で上回った。ナスダックでは値上がり銘柄が値下がり銘柄を１．３８対１の比率で上回った。    米取引所の合計出来高は１４３億７０００万株。直近２０営業日の平均（１７７億６０００万株）を下回った。 

米国株式市場：[.NJP]

＜金先物＞　金は続伸し、１週間ぶり高値を付けた。中心限月の清算値（終値に相当）は１オンス＝４２１６．３ドル。金現物は東部夏時間午後３時２９分（日本時間１０日午前４時２９分）時点で１．５％高の４１９４．３６ドル。今週はドル高や米長期金利の上昇を受けて一時２カ月ぶり安値を付けたが、その後安値拾いの買いが入り、週末にかけて約１．３％の上昇となった。

ＮＹ貴金属：[GOL/XJ]

＜米原油先物＞　反発して取引を終えた。ハリケーン「イサイアス」がメキシコ湾北部に接近し、石油各社が同湾の原油生産の７０％超を停止したことが材料となった。    清算値は、北海ブレント先物が０．４４ドル（０．４２％）高の１バレル＝１０４．７２ドル。米ＷＴＩ先物は０．３６ドル（０．３９％）高の９１．８５ドル。    取引序盤には原油価格は下落していた。トランプ米大統領が８日、１１月の米中間選挙前にイランへの攻撃は実施しないと表明し、戦争の終結に向けて両国は「建設的な」協議を行っていると発言したことを受けた。トランプ氏はまた、ディーゼル燃料に関して近く発表を行うと予告したほか、連邦ガソリン税の一時停止を検討していると述べた。     週間ベースでは、ブレント、ＷＴＩともに上昇の見通し。  

ＮＹＭＥＸエネルギー：[CR/USJ]

＜米原油先物＞　反発して取引を終えた。ハリケーン「イサイアス」がメキシコ湾北部に接近し、石油各社が同湾の原油生産の７０％超を停止したことが材料となった。    清算値は、北海ブレント先物が０．４４ドル（０．４２％）高の１バレル＝１０４．７２ドル。米ＷＴＩ先物は０．３６ドル（０．３９％）高の９１．８５ドル。    取引序盤には原油価格は下落していた。トランプ米大統領が８日、１１月の米中間選挙前にイランへの攻撃は実施しないと表明し、戦争の終結に向けて両国は「建設的な」協議を行っていると発言したことを受けた。トランプ氏はまた、ディーゼル燃料に関して近く発表を行うと予告したほか、連邦ガソリン税の一時停止を検討していると述べた。     週間ベースでは、ブレント、ＷＴＩともに上昇の見通し。

items.title: ロシア、米国向けディーゼル供給開始へ　米ロ首脳が電話会談
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [モスクワ　９日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[モスクワ　９日　ロイター] - ロシアのプーチン大統領は９日、ロシアは米国と世界市場向けに原油や石油製品を供給する用意があると述べ、ロシアによる供給は世界経済全体の支援につながるとの認識を示した。

トランプ米大統領はこれに先立ち、プーチン大統領と電話会談を行い、ロシアが米国と世界市場向けにディーゼル（軽油）３０万トン超を直ちに供給することで合意したと明らかにしていた。

ロシア大統領府が発表した声明によると、両首脳はロシアとウクライナの戦争終結に向けた方策のほか、イラン情勢についても協議した。

米ロ首脳の電話会談を受け、ロシアのノバク副首相は、ロシアは今月中にも米国やその他の国々向けにディーゼル供給を開始する用意があると表明。国内製油所は定期メンテナンス終了後に操業を再開するため、ロシアの石油製品輸出は１１月と１２月にさらに増加するとの見通しを示した。

また、世界のエネルギー市場の安定化を目的とした米国の取り組みを前向きに評価するとし、ディーゼル輸出規制の緩和を直ちに開始すると表明。輸出拡大後も国内市場へのディーゼル供給は十分に確保されると述べた。

items.title: 米国株式市場＝上昇、来週の決算・物価統計に関心　小型株は週間で下落
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ニューヨーク　９日　ロイター］　 -
items.body:
［ニューヨーク　９日　ロイター］　 - 米国株式市場は、主要３指数が揃って上昇して取引を終えた。投資家の関心は、本格化する第３・四半期決算発表や、インフレ指標の発表が予定される来週に移っている。

主要３指数は週間でもプラスとなった。ただ、小型株で構成するラッセル2000指数は前週末終値を下回って引けた。

ベアードの投資ストラテジーアナリスト、ロス・メイフィールド氏は「イランを巡るセンチメントが反転するなど、相場はこれまでと同様に一進一退の展開だ。ホワイトハウスや中東関係者から相反するヘッドラインが出ており、方向感がない」と指摘。「このため、今回の上昇は比較的勢いを欠く」と付け加えた。

第３・四半期の決算発表シーズンは来週本格化する。米大手銀のウェルズ・ファーゴ、ゴールドマン・サックス、シティグループ、ＪＰモルガン・チェース、バンク・オブ・アメリカ、モルガン・スタンレーが決算を発表する予定だ。

ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、アナリストはＳ＆Ｐ５００構成企業の７─９月期利益が前年比３０．６％増加すると予想。セクター別ではエネルギーが１２３％、テクノロジーが６６．５％と、前年比で最大の増益率が見込まれている。

この日は、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００の主要１１セクターのうち、下落したのはコミュニケーション・サービスのみだった。

人工知能（ＡＩ）関連銘柄は総じて上昇。ラウンドヒル・マグニフィセント・セブンＥＴＦは１％上昇した。

米実業家イーロン・マスク氏率いるスペースＸは８日、全米をカバーする低周波数帯の利用権を取得する契約を結んだ。

これを受けて通信大手ＴモバイルＵＳ、ＡＴ＆Ｔ、ベライゾンは８．８─１３．３％下落した。

アップルは１．１％下落した。メモリーチップのコスト高騰と値上げが消費者需要を冷やす中、同社が一部サプライヤーに対し、新発売した「ｉＰｈｏｎｅ１８　Ｐｒｏ」と「ｉＰｈｏｎｅ１８　Ｐｒｏ　Ｍａｘ」向け部品の生産を削減するよう指示したと報じられた。

ニューヨーク証券取引所（ＮＹＳＥ）では値上がり銘柄数が値下がり銘柄数を１．６５対１の比率で上回った。ナスダックでは値上がり銘柄が値下がり銘柄を１．３８対１の比率で上回った。

米取引所の合計出来高は１４３億７０００万株。直近２０営業日の平均（１７７億６０００万株）を下回った。

items.title: ゼレンスキー氏、米ロのディーゼル供給合意を非難　「戦争への投資」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [９日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[９日　ロイター] - ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は９日、米国とロシアがロシア産ディーゼル（軽油）の供給で合意したことについて、「終わらせるべき戦争への投資だ」と非難した。

ゼレンスキー氏は「ロシアのプーチン大統領に対する贈り物は、平和も、文明世界へのいかなる利益ももたらさない」とＸに投稿。「ロシアによる石油製品の販売を認めることは、終わらせるべき戦争を長引かせるための投資だ」とし、「必要なのはロシアとの相互的な形での真の緊張緩和だ」と訴えた。

さらにその後、通信アプリ「ワッツアップ」で記者団に対し、ウクライナ代表団がロシアとの戦争終結への協議に向けた訪米中に発表されたこの合意について、「われわれのチームは体裁を取り繕うために利用されているに過ぎないと考えている。それは決して公正ではないし、パートナー同士がとるべき態度でもない」と非難。「私の見方では、これは強い立場にあるパートナーが下した弱腰な決定だ」と述べた。 

トランプ米大統領はこの日、プーチン大統領との「極めて成功した」協議の結果、ロシアが米国と世界市場向けにディーゼル（軽油）３０万トン超を直ちに供給することで合意したと明らかにした。

ゼレンスキー大統領は前日、ロシアとウクライナの和平を仲介する米国主導の取り組みの一環として、ウクライナ代表団が９─１０日に米国で協議を行うと明らかにしていた。

items.title: 米アンソロピックのＡＩモデル、虚偽の殺人情報を警察サイトに送信
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[９日 ロイター] - 米人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業アンソロピックのＡＩモデルが、ペンシルベニア州フィラデルフィア市警のウェブサイトを通じて虚偽の殺人事件に関する情報提供を行っていたことが分かった。同市警が声明で明らかにした。ＡＩモデルが制御不能となり、意図しない結果を引き起こした最新の事例となる。 

警察によると、アンソロピックは今週に入り警察に通知し、自動化されたテストプロセスが原因で情報が送信されたと説明したという。

警察は「送信情報はスパムと判定され、捜査上の精査や情報共有のためにリアルタイム犯罪センターに転送されることはなかった」と説明。アンソロピックから、この件に関する報告書を９日に公表する意向だと伝えられたと述べた。アンソロピックは当局に対し、事案の発覚後にテストプロセスを停止し、今後のテストに向けて追加の検証メカニズムを導入したと説明したという。 

急速に進展するＡＩ技術を巡っては、ＡＩエージェントが暴走して企業のコンピューターネットワークに侵入したとの報告や、将来的に人類の存続を脅かしかねないとする著名研究者らの警告が相次いでおり、米国内で大きな関心事となっている。

アンソロピックはコメント要請に直ちに応じなかった。

items.title: Erik Prince's forces suffer battlefield loss in Congo, former UFC fighter among wounded, sources say
items.author: Jessica Donati
items.creator: Jessica Donati
items.summary: Popular former UFC fighter Tim Kennedy was among the wounded in an ambush that killed or wounded at least 20 people deployed by Vectus Global.
items.body:
Blackwater founder Erik Prince's forces suffered a major battlefield loss in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo in mid-September when enemy forces ambushed them, killing and wounding at least 20 people, including a popular former UFC fighter, sources close to the government and his company said.
The frontline clash shows how Prince, an ally and supporter of US President Donald Trump, has taken on an expanded role in Congo through his company Vectus Global. The company, which also operates in Haiti and other parts of Africa, provides consulting and security services and previously [USN:L6N3XA0X0 TEXT:"helped Congo’s army"] secure the city of Uvira in South Kivu against Rwanda-backed rebels who control swathes of the east.
A veteran special operator reported on his podcast earlier this week that former US Green Beret and Ultimate Fighting Championship contestant Tim Kennedy was injured in Congo. The involvement of Prince's forces and the number of casualties have not previously been reported.
The attack in South Kivu on September 17 left about 20 dead and wounded, two sources working with Congo's government said. The dead included at least seven Congolese and a former member of New Zealand's Special Forces, while the wounded included Kennedy and another foreign contractor, the sources said.
A Vectus Global representative declined to comment. The company has not previously suffered casualties in Congo, a source with direct knowledge of the operation said.
One of the sources who works for Congo's government said that Rwandan forces backing the M23 rebels may have surprised them by tracking a drone used for surveillance operations to their location.
Spokespeople for the Congolese and Rwandan governments and for the M23 did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
Kennedy, the former mixed martial arts fighter, survived the attack with three gunshot wounds to the leg, three sources said, and is being treated at the Walter Reed National Military Medical Center in the suburbs of Washington.
Kennedy has a popular podcast channel and millions of followers on social media. Trump is a fan of UFC, [USN:L6N42N00Z TEXT:"hosting fights"] at the White House this year.
The US State Department and Walter Reed declined to comment. Kennedy's parents did not respond to requests for comment.
A Congolese security source, who said some 20 people were wounded and killed in the attack, added that villagers were likely among the casualties as well. Reuters spoke to at least 10 sources either with direct knowledge of the attack or briefed on the outcome.
PRINCE TOOK EXPANDED ROLE IN CONGO'S CONFLICT Prince's initial mandate in Congo was to secure and improve revenue collection from the country's vast mineral reserves, which have been plundered for decades, fuelling relentless conflict in the east.
But in January and early February, his forces deployed to Uvira after Washington helped broker a deal for Rwandan-backed rebels to withdraw from the strategic town.
The size of Prince's forces in Congo is unclear.
One of the sources with direct knowledge of the attack said the Vectus team was travelling between locations when the ambush took place and its sophistication suggested Rwandan forces were involved.
"It reinforces the need for DRC sovereignty to be restored. It's an incredibly dangerous place right now," the source said.
Two other sources said the ambush was carried out by the Rwandan military.
Prince is the founder of now-defunct private military firm Blackwater, some of whose members were pardoned in 2020 for killing Iraqi civilians.
The State Department has said it does not have any contracts with Prince in Congo, though US officials have said they plan to work [USN:L1N43O0RW TEXT:"more closely with Vectus Global"] in Haiti.
The deal for Rwandan-backed rebels to withdraw from Uvira was part of [USN:L6N3XA0X0 TEXT:"wider agreements"] brokered by the Trump administration to try to end the conflict in eastern Congo.
POPULAR PODCASTER Kennedy, a father of four, has posted his views on politics, culture, fitness and more on social media. He also runs a popular YouTube podcast in which he interviews UFC fighters, veterans, cultural disruptors and others.
He has often posted about his family, including four young children. In late August, he posted about having "incredible conversations about what being a man means and what sacrifice really looks like" with his son. He did not disclose details about his upcoming trip to Congo.
The United Nations and Western powers say Rwanda backs M23, even exercising command and control over the group. Rwanda denies this. Fighting in the decades-long conflict flared early last year, with M23 fighters making rapid gains in the east, which is rich in tantalum, gold, lithium and other minerals.

items.title: ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル堅調、ユーロは5週連続下落　ＦＲＢ当局者発言待ち
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ニューヨーク　９日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ニューヨーク　９日　ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対しやや上昇した。市場で様子見姿勢が強まる中、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の金融政策の行方を見極めようと、ＦＲＢ当局者の発言が注目されている。

終盤の取引でドルは対円で０．２５％高の１５８．２５円。週間ベースで円は対ドルで４週連続で下落した。

ユーロ／ドルは０．１％安の１．１１９８ドル。週間ベースでは約０．５％下落した。週間ベースでは５週連続の下落で、２０２５年初旬以降で最長となった。ユーロはフランスの公的債務などに対する懸念などが重荷になり、５日の取引で１．１１６１ドルと１年５カ月ぶりの安値を更新していた。

世界の債券市場はこれまで売りが優勢だったが、トランプ米大統領が中間選挙前にイランを攻撃しないと表明し原油価格が下落したことなどで、この日は落ち着きを取り戻した。マネーコープ（コネティカット州スタンフォード）のトレーディング・ストラクチャード商品部門責任者、ユージン・エプスタイン氏は、この日の取引について「様子見姿勢が強い」と指摘。「ドル相場はＦＲＢ当局者の発言に反応しやすい状況になっているため、誰もがＦＲＢ当局者の発言が一巡するのを待っている」と述べた。

ＣＭＥフェドウオッチによると、２７─２８日の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で少なくとも０．２５％ポイントの利上げが決定される確率は１９．４％。ただ、その次の１２月８─９日のＦＯＭＣで利上げが決定される確率は８５．８％と、年内に追加利上げが実施されるとの観測は依然として強い。

来週はウォーシュＦＲＢ議長が１６日にタイのバンコクで開かれる国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）年次総会で講演を行う。

主要通貨に対するドル指数は０．１３％高の１０２．２５。週間ベースでは約０．３％上昇。上昇は４週連続で、２５年５月以来の長さとなる。

items.title: 国連、米の銃殺刑ライブ配信計画「忌まわしい」　拷問禁止違反の可能性
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [９日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[９日　ロイター] - 国連は９日、２００９年に米南部テキサス州のフォートフッド陸軍基地で１３人を殺害した銃撃犯の死刑執行をライブ配信するという米国の計画について、「忌まわしい」と批判し、拷問禁止規定に違反する可能性があると述べた。

国連のドゥジャリク報道官はニューヨークでの定例記者会見で、「イランやアフガニスタンなど他国で見られてきたこうした公開処刑は、残虐で非人道的、または品位を傷つける扱いや刑罰の一形態となり得る」と非難した。 

さらに「これを生中継することは公開処刑に等しく、拷問禁止規定の違反となる可能性がある」とした上で、「政府が公の場や生中継のカメラの前で誰かを処刑することは、率直に言って忌まわしい行為だ」と述べた。

米国防総省は、同陸軍基地で銃を乱射し１３人を殺害した元陸軍精神科医のニダル・ハサン死刑囚について、１２月３日に予定されている軍による銃殺刑の執行をライブ配信すると明らかにした。銃殺刑は１９４５年以来初めてとなる。
